meta.subtitle: 独立于业务词表的名称探索；后缀决定抽样名额，实际网页决定内容判断。
meta.sourceNote: 复用同一批30份WhoisDS免费日名单；供应商子集，不是全球全量。
meta.launchNote: 近期注册且当前有内容，不等于确认首次在本月上线。

screening.method: 从只读SQLite seen表逐域名执行此版本规则；通过清单CSV含名称路径/分词/词根诊断/来源编号及旧探测重合；source_files.json将编号还原到原始路径。排除原因按首个匹配规则计数。所有失败域名仍在原SQLite；按同一词典和脚本可复算单域判定。对未探测通过者依后缀组内SHA256取前N，N见sampling.actual_group_quotas。词典、脚本与配置文件均随项目保存。

channels.label: 传统后缀
channels.rule: 后缀在.com, .net, .org，且通过相同的名称线索规则；没有行业词根要求。

channels.label: 产品与技术后缀
channels.rule: 后缀在.ai, .io, .app, .dev, .tech，且通过相同的名称线索规则；没有行业词根要求。

channels.label: 其他常见选择
channels.rule: 后缀在.co, .me, .cc, .tv，且通过相同的名称线索规则；没有行业词根要求。

channels.label: 其余后缀探索
channels.rule: 后缀在剩余全部合规输入后缀，且通过相同的名称线索规则；没有行业词根要求。

notes: 词典或字符模式不能确认名称有意义；词典偏英语，年代旧，含罕见词及专名。
筛选失败只表示本通道未覆盖，不能认定域名无意义或无价值；旧完整输入仍保留。
IDN 编码名称暂未做多语言分词；可由其他独立通道处理。所有后缀均有分组，没有被后缀直接排除。
名单日期是供应商批次日期；注册日期、首次上线、网页用途、关键词需求均尚未由名称筛选核实。
后缀分组仅用于分配检查名额，不代表权威、注册成本或Google排名优势。其他后缀同样保留探索名额。
词典分词、可读造词和短名称都是粗筛线索，不能判断真实含义、恶意行为或网站商业价值。
与前轮已实探域名去重；两个方法的抽样池和配额不同，候选比例不能作为严格优劣实验结论。
按与月度轮相同的页面和RDAP规则核验；AI内容复核单独保存且保留自动初判。
网页Title、Description和H1原文片段尚未整理成最终搜索词，本轮Google Trends、流量及竞争度均未核验。
Trends以最近30个完整日判断近期是否持续起量，半年仅作辅助背景；较早的0可能是低于展示阈值，不能断言之前无人搜索。
孤立尖峰可能来自统计噪声；第一次非零仅是查询窗口内首次可见，仍需更长历史和多日持续性核对。
后续研究暂跳过明确成人与博彩类别；这是研究范围假设，不是对所有此类网站的质量判定。公开记录用中性编号替代这些域名，不展示其原文、地址或趋势入口。

nameRules.label: alphanumeric_exploration
nameRules.rule: 带数字名称优先独立分类：长度2–16，数字≤2且占去连字符长度≤40%；去数字与连字符后的字母部分可完整分词，或满足可读模式，或长度2–5。保留 b2b 等缩写/少量数字，不承诺数字的含义。

nameRules.label: dictionary_segments
nameRules.rule: 无数字名称按每个连字符分块，每块必须全部由词典中长度3–32的词覆盖；总计最多5词。优先词数最少，再按词元字典序确定唯一切分。没有行业或关键词白名单。

nameRules.label: short_abbreviation
nameRules.rule: 词典无法完整覆盖时，保留2–5个纯字母且无连字符的短名称；不要求元音。缩写与短随机串在此无法区分。

nameRules.label: readable_coinage
nameRules.rule: 余下无数字名称去连字符后长度5–20；每个连字符分块≥2字母；a/e/i/o/u/y占20%–70%；无连续5个非元音或连续4个元音。只是形态线索，仍会纳入随机串并漏掉真实品牌。

exclusionLabels.encoded_idn: IDN 编码名称暂未做多语言分词，保留在旧完整输入中
exclusionLabels.name_length_outside_2_32: 名称长度不在 2–32 字符
exclusionLabels.too_many_hyphens: 超过两个连字符或存在连续连字符
exclusionLabels.repeated_character_run: 存在至少四个连续相同字符
exclusionLabels.too_many_digits: 数字超过两位或占比超过40%
exclusionLabels.alphanumeric_no_name_clue: 带数字名称的字母部分未达到词典/可读/短缩写线索
exclusionLabels.no_dictionary_or_readability_clue: 未取得完整词典分词或本轮可读字符形态线索

h1: A Jewish learning journey, PreK through Grade 6.
domains.visibleText: How it works Curriculum For congregations Sign in A Jewish learning journey, PreK through Grade 6. Masa runs two tracks side by side every week — Judaica Studies and Nativ , our Hebrew ladder — so children grow in belonging and in reading at the same time. For congregations & schools See how it works What an afternoon looks like The same rhythm every week, so children always know where they are — and it grows with them. Through Grade 1 it is one class with one teacher , with Hebrew woven in by ear. From Grade 2, Hebrew becomes its own hour with its own teacher. PREK – GRADE 1 Class 120 min · in class Snack 15 min · together T'filah 45 min · in the sanctuary GRADES 2 – 6 Eitz Chayim 60 min · in class Nativ (Hebrew) 60 min · in class Snack 15 min · together T'filah 45 min · in the sanctuary 180 minutes in all. Eitz Chayim — Widening Circles of Belonging Each year the circle grows — from the child and the rhythm of the year, outward to values, practice, time, peoplehood, and Torah. PREK–KINDERGARTEN My Jewish Year 13 units · 22 sessions GRADE 1 My Jewish Values 13 units · 24 sessions GRADE 2 My Jewish Practice 10 units · 23 sessions GRADE 3 Jewish Time 13 units · 24 sessions GRADE 4 My Jewish People 10 units · 24 sessions GRADE 5 A Jewish Life 15 units · 25 sessions GRADE 6 Torah & Becoming a Leader 11 units · 22 sessions Nativ — The Hebrew Star Path Every letter is a star. Every set becomes a constellation. A sound only becomes a star once a child can produce it on three different days, in three different activities — so progress means something. שׁ sh ל l מ m א the silent seat בּ b/v ה h ו v · oh · oo י y תּ t ד d Level 1, taught in Grade 2 · Read real pointed words with AH, EE, OH and OO. Your companions travel the path with you Ari אַרְיֵה The bold one. Ari makes the big, held sounds and cheers the first word you ever read. Ya'ela יַעֲלָה The climber. Ya’ela sings sounds up the mountain and keeps a steady, patient pace. Or אוֹר The quiet light. Or holds the hush before a candle is lit, and lights each star you earn. The circle widens every year. Masa מַסָּע — journey

h1: Your guests come once. The problem is not your marketing .
domains.visibleText: MERIDWICK The Problem Method Engagement Contact Instagram Your guests come once. The problem is not your marketing . We help restaurant and hospitality groups across the Gulf find out why guests don't come back — from your own data, not from guesswork. Request a free analysis See the engagement THE PROBLEM You pay a full acquisition cost for every guest, over and over When the numbers soften, the first assumption is always that the answer is more ad spend. In most cases the failure sits elsewhere — between the moment a guest books and the moment they leave. And your internal team is part of the picture, so it cannot see what the guest sees. 01 Data nobody reads Hundreds of published reviews about your branches hold a precise answer. Nobody codes them by branch, month and theme. 02 Branches drift quietly A single issue can concentrate in one branch for months before it ever surfaces in the financials. 03 Fixes with no priority A list of problems with no ranking by impact never gets executed. Execution needs three clear steps, not thirty recommendations. MERIDIAN noun The reference line from which direction and position are measured. Every group we work with already has the data. What it lacks is the line to measure from. THE MERIDIAN METHOD Four stages — from fixing position to holding the result 01 Locate Full review analysis across every branch and platform, the digital journey walked to checkout, and a benchmark against three competitors. 02 Chart Map the guest journey and mark the leak points, ranking every issue by its effect on repeat rate relative to the cost of fixing it. 03 Correct A 90-day implementation plan: who does what and when, designed to be executed by your own team without ongoing dependence on us. 04 Hold Quarterly measurement tracking the effect of the changes on repeat rate, preventing a slide back to where you started. SIGNATURE ENGAGEMENT THE RETURN AUDIT Three weeks · delivered entirely remotely Every review across every branch over twelve months, coded by theme, branch and month The digital journey walked: booking and ordering across your site, app and every delivery platform Response audit: reply rate on reviews, median response time and quality Benchmark against three competitors over the same period Video sessions with the owner and branch managers Executive report, guest journey map, 90-day plan and a presentation session Start with a free analysis WHY MERIDWICK Operating experience inside restaurants, not reading about them Built, not just advised Hands-on background in restaurant and F&B setup and operations — we know the difference between a menu problem, a flow problem and a training problem. The principal does the work No junior teams, no account layer. The person on your first call is the person who runs the engagement. domains.visibleText: Skip to content WHAT IS LIFE ABOUT? Explore What Matters Most Life brings questions about meaning, purpose, relationships, God, faith, suffering, and what comes next. You do not need to have everything figured out. This is a place to explore honestly, at your own pace. Help Me Find Where to Start Explore the Questions A PLACE TO EXPLORE You are welcome to bring your questions. Some questions are too important for quick answers. You may be wondering about your purpose, whether God exists, why life can be painful, whether faith still makes sense, or whether there is something more. Start wherever you are. Choose a question that matters to you, or let us help you find a good place to begin. NOT SURE WHERE TO BEGIN? Find a place to start. Answer a few simple questions about what you are thinking about right now. We will point you toward an area that may be worth exploring first. Help Me Find Where to Start EXPLORE What are you thinking about? Choose the question that feels closest to where you are today. There is no required order. 01 Does My Life Have a Purpose? Explore questions about meaning, identity, direction, significance, and what makes a life worth living. Explore this question → 02 Is There More to Life Than This? Consider why people often sense that life may be about more than achievement, possessions, or simply getting by. Explore this question → 03 Is There Really a God? Explore belief, doubt, spirituality, evidence, experience, and the possibility that there is more beyond what we see. Explore this question → 04 Why Is There So Much Suffering? Consider questions about pain, loss, evil, injustice, disappointment, and where God might fit into a hurting world. Explore this question → 05 Can Faith Still Make Sense? Explore whether faith can be thoughtful, honest, and meaningful in a world shaped by science, skepticism, and competing ideas. Explore this question → 06 What If Religion Has Let Me Down? Explore questions that come from disappointment, hypocrisy, hurt, bad experiences, or uncertainty about organized religion. Explore this question → WHEN YOU ARE READY Some questions lead to deeper questions. As you explore, you may begin asking more specific questions about Christianity, Jesus, prayer, the Bible, or what it means to trust God. Those questions are welcome too. You do not need to begin there. You can start with the question that matters most to you today. Explore deeper questions → ABOUT SEEK Explore honestly. Move at your own pace. SEEK was created to give people a thoughtful place to explore questions about life, meaning, God, faith, and spiritual things. h1: Long private journeys across four countries , drawn one party at a time
domains.visibleText: Skip to content Trip planning +84 766 091 399 Indochina Voyagers Menu Journeys Where to go Planning Prices About Contact Enquire Private journeys, 13 – 28 days Long private journeys across four countries , drawn one party at a time Indochina Voyagers builds journeys of thirteen to twenty-eight days through Vietnam, Cambodia, Laos and Thailand. One party travels at a time — a couple, a family, a set of friends — with a private car and driver plus a national guide in each country, and every hotel named in the quote before you pay anything. Plan my trip 4 countries 12 journeys 13 – 28 days 2 travellers minimum Three ways into the same four countries Most people arrive here in one of three states. Pick the one that matches yours and skip the rest of this page. 01 You want the journey booked Twelve routes, thirteen to twenty-eight days, each with a night-by-night itinerary and a land-only price. Start at the journeys and take the one whose shape is closest to yours; the itinerary is a sketch we redraw, not a fixed product. 02 You know the place, not the trip Fifteen destination pages covering Hanoi, Lan Ha Bay, Hue, Hoi An, Siem Reap, Luang Prabang, Bangkok, Chiang Mai, Koh Samui and the rest. Each one says how many nights the place actually holds and which month ruins it. 03 You have dates and nothing else Start with planning : how many days the region needs, when to go, the visa and arrival-card position for all four countries, and which legs have to be flown rather than driven. The one fact that rearranges most Indochina itineraries this year Thailand – Cambodia land border: closed Every crossing has been shut since 23 June 2025 — Poipet–Aranyaprathet, Cham Yeam–Hat Lek, O’Smach–Chong Jom and Ban Pakard–Pailin. Armed clashes followed in July 2025 and again in December 2025. The ceasefire is holding through 2026, and Thai authorities have said there is no plan to reopen during this calendar year. Older itineraries move travellers from Bangkok to Siem Reap by road, or run a Phnom Penh–Trat transfer down to the Thai islands. Neither leg exists at the moment. An operator still showing an overland Bangkok–Siem Reap day is selling a day it cannot run, and the substitution arrives as a surprise once you are already in the region. How we route around it Bangkok to Siem Reap is flown: about 1 h 15 min in the air, then a 45 to 60 minute transfer from Siem Reap–Angkor International (SAI), which sits 40 to 50 km from town. Bangkok to Phnom Penh is also flown, landing at Techo International (KTI), 19 km south of the city — international traffic moved there on 9 September 2025 and the old airport now handles domestic flights only. Where a journey needs both Thailand and Cambodia, the two countries sit at opposite ends of the route rather than in the middle, so the flight replaces a transit day instead of interrupting one. Митрофана Воронежского. В 1995 году преподавателем иконописного класса о. Димитрий назначает Наталию Петровну Маслову, которая по его же благословению в это время обучалась иконописи в мастерской храма Свт. Николая в Клениках ( на Маросейке) у известного иконописца Ирины Васильевны Ватагиной . Ирина Васильевна Ватагина (1924-2007гг) – выдающийся иконописец, художник – реставратор высшей категории, была профессором Свято-Тихоновского университета и ближайшей ученицей знаменитого иконописца монахини Иулиании (Марии Николаевны Соколовой (1899-1981гг)), сохранившей и передавшей своим преемником и последователям технику древнерусской иконописи яичной темперой по деревянной доске , загрунтованной меловым левкасом. Протоиерей Димитрий Смирнов (1951-2020гг) с самого основания иконописного класса, а потом и школы , становится его руководителем, вдохновителем, главным консультантом и экспертом. Он внимательно отслеживал учебный процесс и участвовал в духовном становлении начинающих иконописцев. Преподавание в школе ведется по методике, разработанной при активным участие о. Димитрия (по образованию художника) и Ирины Васильевны Ватагиной, которая начиная с 1995 г. до своей блаженной кончины проявляла живейший интерес к нашему обучению, консультировала, вникала во все подробности , помогала советами и направляла в школу новых учеников . С начала 2000-х годов Батюшка благословляет внести в программу обучения написание учащимися курсовых и дипломных икон. Иконы учащихся после просмотра по благословению о. Димитрия передаются в дар нашему приходу и Батюшка по своему усмотрению определял их либо в иконное хранилище наших храмов , либо в подарочный фонд. domains.visibleText: truelint Guides Checks vs Screaming Frog Pricing Download Open-source core · v0.1 for macOS A linter for your website. Truelint crawls your site the way a linter reads code: every page, every link, 125 checks, each with a plain-English fix. It runs on your Mac, in your terminal, or in a browser, and a million URLs fit in 210 MB of memory. Download for macOS Compare with Screaming Frog Free up to 1,000 URLs per crawl · No account · Your crawls never leave your machine 125 checks, each with how-to-fix guidance written for developers 1M URLs crawled in 307 seconds on a laptop, 210 MB peak memory 9× faster than Screaming Frog on the same 20,000-URL site, 14× less memory 8 MB installer. Single-file crawls you can open, share and compare later What it finds Every technical SEO problem, with the fix attached. Grouped by severity, filtered by tab, exported in one click. The wording was written for the person who has to change the page. Broken links and redirect chains 4xx and 5xx targets, chains, loops, meta refreshes, mixed content, and which pages link to each of them. Duplicate and thin content Exact and near-duplicate detection on the main content only, so a shared sidebar never counts twice. Canonicals, directives, hreflang Missing, conflicting and non-indexable canonicals; noindex leaks; hreflang without return links; sitemap orphans. Structured data validation Required and recommended properties for 35 schema.org types, rich-result eligibility per item. JavaScript rendering Renders with Chrome, diffs raw versus rendered titles, links and content, and catches JavaScript-only redirects. Accessibility and mobile axe-core on every rendered page with WCAG tags; content wider than the screen, tiny text, tap targets. Extraction, search, AI CSS, XPath and regex extraction; source-code search; per-page prompts to your own OpenAI, Anthropic or Ollama. Compare crawls Open two crawls of the same site and see exactly which pages changed, appeared, or broke since last time. How it works Three steps. Minutes, not afternoons. 01 Enter a URL Or paste a list. Configure scope, rendering, extraction and auth if you need them; the defaults are right for most sites. 02 Read the Issues pane Findings grouped by severity as the crawl runs. Click one to filter the grid to every affected page, with the specific detail per URL. 03 Hand over the fix Export the view, a rule, or one of the bulk reports. Re-crawl next month and compare to prove the work landed. Measured, not claimed Same site, same laptop, same five threads. 20,000 HTML pages served locally, JavaScript rendering off, MacBook Pro 16 GB. Screaming Frog 22.2 with default memory. Full comparison and caveats. Time to crawl 20,000 URLs Truelint 4.6 s Screaming Frog 42.3 s Peak memory Truelint 72 MB Screaming Frog 1,009 MB Three front doors, one engine Desktop, terminal, or browser. Desktop app Native macOS app. Crawls are single files you can open, share and compare later. Windows and Linux builds are coming. Command

h1: Compare AI tools before your compliance team has to explain them
domains.visibleText: Attestly . Directory How ratings work About Compare AI tools before your compliance team has to explain them A working directory of AI tools used by advisers, banks and insurers — filtered by what actually matters to a regulated firm: data handling, training policy, and audit trail, not just features. Read this first. Attestly summarizes public vendor documentation to help you narrow a search. It is not legal or compliance advice, and it doesn't replace your own due diligence or your compliance officer's sign-off. Some listings link to vendors through referral partnerships — see "How ratings work" below. Category All Meeting notes & transcription AI governance & monitoring Research & analysis Fraud & AML Communications archiving Must have No training on client data SOC 2 Type II Listings 25 tools No tools match those filters yet. Try clearing one. How ratings work Content last fact-checked: 23 September 2026 Each badge reflects what a vendor states in its own security documentation, trust center, or public policies — not an independent audit performed by Attestly. We link to primary sources where we can and flag anything we can't confirm as "unverified" rather than guessing. Vendor participation is free. Where a vendor offers a referral or affiliate program, we may earn a commission if you sign up through a link on this site. That never changes which tools are listed or how they're rated — commission status is not a filter you can search by, and it isn't shown as a badge. Spot something out of date or incorrect? We rely on public documentation that changes over time, and we get things wrong occasionally. If you're a vendor or a visitor and see a badge, note, or fact that needs updating, email hello@attestlyhq.com with what's changed and a source where we can confirm it — we review every request and correct genuine errors promptly. Before you sign a contract Confirm the vendor's current SOC 2 report and training policy directly — this page is a starting point, not a substitute for their latest documentation. Work out where the tool sits under the EU AI Act's risk tiers. The Digital Omnibus package pushed the Annex III high-risk deadline from August 2026 to 2 December 2027, so there's runway — but systems that determine creditworthiness or credit scoring, price or assess risk for life and health insurance, or drive fraud-detection decisions affecting someone's access to financial services are still named high-risk and will carry heavy documentation, oversight and conformity-assessment duties once that date arrives. Note that transparency obligations (disclosing AI interactions) were not delayed and already apply. Meeting-notes and general research tools are typically "limited risk" — but check before assuming, especially if a tool's output ever feeds a credit, pricing or eligibility decision. domains.visibleText: Meaning Making Counselling Home Info About Contact Me ------ Meaning Making Counselling Welcome. What is Meaning Making Counselling? Counselling is a space where you can explore and find a sense of purpose within major life events. It is a supportive, non-judgemental space where you can navigate what life might be asking of you in this moment. I help clients feel and process through difficult emotions and experiences. I draw from and integrate various frameworks such as: Existential, Spiritual, Depth Psychology, Somatic, Family Systems and Anti-Oppression. Counselling vs. Psychotherapy Counselling is different from psychotherapy as it does not address severe underlying mental health conditions and mood disorders. Counselling is suited for folks who have a pull towards self awareness and self exploration. Couples Counselling Couples counselling is a place where you and your partner can deepen your connection to each other. It's never just about the sock on the floor or the dishes in the sink but the perpectives behind these gestures. What might seem like a harmless glass left on the kitchen counter to one partner, can feel like an invasion to the other. Together we can build healthier connection and understanding. It's not that we have to avoid arguments with our partners but to recognize the fight is a bid for closeness and connection. How Counselling Works The process of counselling would begin by booking an initial consultation to see if we might be a suitable fit to work together. If we do move forward together, we then meet for sessions regularly, either weekly or bi-weekly. In the sessions, clients may explore concerns such as anxiety, stress, relationship challenges and life transitions. Our work is collaborative and tailored to your goals, pace, and personal background. Depending on your needs, sessions may blend talk with somatic techniques to help you build emotional regulation, deepen self-awareness, and reconnect with a sense of safety. ABOUT ME My name is Hoiking Fung. I have been practicing as a Counsellor since 2019, supporting individuals and couples. I studied Existential Integrative Psychotherapy at The Living Institute. I came to this work through my own healing journey. Never in the previous versions of myself, did I ever think of counselling as a path. My life focus was on the arts, as I studied drawing and painting in my childhood, adolescence and my early 20's. In my mid to late 20's I was not feeling much meaning in my life trajectory at the time. I would research different spiritual paths, attend different gatherings. Still, my thirst for deeper answers about existence was not found in these groups. In my early 30's I went into counselling to better understand my own life circumstances and past traumas as it was affecting my life at the moment. Teste auffällige Eingaben mehrmals und möglichst mit einer zweiten Verbindungsart. La tecnologia è stata sviluppata da un gruppo di specialisti con base in Italia, orientati alla creazione di soluzioni di nuova generazione per l'analisi finanziaria. Oggi, con l'evoluzione dell'AI, quell'idea è diventata concreta - ed è così che è nato Nexork System." Qaiser Sajjad Un approccio nuovo all'analisi dei mercati Un approccio nuovo all'analisi dei mercati I mercati finanziari producono quantità enormi di dati. I sistemi tradizionali li elaborano in sequenza e spesso lasciano sfuggire segnali importanti. Nexork System lavora in modo diverso: la piattaforma analizza i dati in modo più ampio e veloce, così puoi vedere di più in meno tempo. Alla base di Nexork System c'è la combinazione di tre tecnologie: 1. Algoritmi di analisi evoluti Il sistema riconosce schemi complessi e relazioni nei dati che sono difficili da individuare manualmente. 2. Modelli di apprendimento automatico Gli algoritmi si addestrano sui dati di mercato e imparano a riconoscere comportamenti, inversioni di tendenza e possibili punti di ingresso. 3. Elaborazione ad alta velocità L'analisi in parallelo consente di valutare più rapidamente il contesto e reagire subito ai cambiamenti, senza attese. Tutto questo porta il vantaggio più importante: prendere decisioni guidate dai dati, non dalle emozioni o dalle supposizioni. domains.description: Personal website of Cristian Ramírez, PhD in Computer Science, focused on AI, embedded systems, high-performance computing, RISC-V, machine learning, and applied research.
domains.visibleText: Toggle navigation about (current) blog projects publications Cristian Ramírez Department of Computing Engineering • Parallel Arquitecture Group . I am Cristian Ramírez, a PhD in Computer Science with a strong engineering background in artificial intelligence, embedded systems, high-performance computing, and computer architecture. My work focuses on building efficient computing solutions for machine learning and numerical applications, with particular interest in RISC-V systems, embedded AI, heterogeneous computing, performance optimization, and hardware-software co-design. My experience combines research and implementation in performance-critical environments, including matrix computation optimization, deep learning acceleration, low-level code generation, and efficient execution on constrained and parallel architectures. I enjoy turning complex technical ideas into practical solutions and contributing to projects that connect advanced research with real-world engineering challenges. I am currently open to industry opportunities in AI systems, embedded and edge computing, high-performance computing, RISC-V, ML infrastructure, and software optimization. I am open to research and industry opportunities in AI, embedded systems, HPC, RISC-V, and machine learning engineering. Découvrir nos produits Nous contacter Emballage Industriel • Fabrication Certifiée • Algérie & International 01 — À PROPOS Une expertise industrielle au service de vos produits. FRT Industry est une entreprise industrielle algérienne spécialisée dans la fabrication de sacs tissés et de solutions d'emballage. Nous mettons à votre disposition une équipe professionnelle et expérimentée, des équipements modernes et un accompagnement de proximité, avec un engagement constant envers la qualité et des délais de fabrication maîtrisés. En savoir plus Une relation de confiance avec nos clients et partenaires. Assurer la sécurité, l'étanchéité et la valorisation visuelle de vos matières premières avec des standards certifiés. — NOS CAPACITÉS Des solutions techniques et performantes. Fabrication industrielle Sacs tissés de haute qualité et grande résistance, adaptés aux charges lourdes et contraintes sévères. Personnalisation Dimensions, grammages, soufflets, coloris et impressions entièrement configurés sur mesure. Impression Flexo Impression flexographique haute définition jusqu'à 6 couleurs avec traitement corona pour encrage optimal. Assistance technique Conseil technique continu et accompagnement pointu dans le choix des compositions matières. Contrôle qualité Vérification systématique en laboratoire à chaque étape de la fabrication (traction, étanchéité, chute). Service client Écoute, réactivité maximale, gestion proactive des commandes et suivi personnalisé des livraisons. 02 — NOS PRODUITS Nos solutions d'emballage Des produits conçus pour répondre aux exigences techniques de chaque secteur industriel. h1: What if what is in you could change everything?
domains.visibleText: STARFISH FLOAT .ORG The calling What you bring What could grow Emerging initiatives Answer the call ↗ A MISSION OF HEALING, COMPASSION, AND POSSIBILITY What if what is in you could change everything? Not because you can do everything. Because the prayer, idea, skill, connection, time, or resource you carry could become the beginning of something none of us could build alone. Step into the invitation ↓ I already feel the call ↗ HEALING BEGINS WITH A LIFE THE HORIZON HAS NO EDGE HELP IS PART OF THE MISSION If you need help, begin here. We believe helping people matters right now, not only someday. Help Finds a Way offers a developing collection of starting points and resources available today. It is not yet a staffed help service, but there may be a useful next step for you. Find Help Now Explore U.S. government benefits Looking for other options? Browse official government assistance resources ↗ 01 THE FEELING YOU CANNOT SHAKE You know there is more! You can have children you love, friends who know you, family around you, meaningful work, and a life many would call complete, and still feel it: there is more you were meant to give. What am I here to give? That restlessness is not ingratitude. It is the quiet knowledge that your life is meant to reach beyond itself and leave a mark that outlives you. That is the call waiting to be answered. The need waiting to be served. The music inside you waiting to be released. LOOK AGAIN AT WHAT REMAINS IN YOU Your gifts were never meant to end with you! You have learned things. Survived things. Built things. Lost things. Met people. Earned trust. Developed instincts no résumé can fully explain. What if all of it has been preparing you to serve in a way you could not previously see? God does not need you to arrive with everything. He asks you to bring what is already in your hands. HEALING CREATES ROOM FOR WHAT COMES NEXT Breathe. Let go. Let yourself be held. StarfishFloat.org begins with the truth that people need more than solutions. We need space to exhale, recover, reconnect, and remember that possibility is still larger than what has happened to us. Healing is not the limit of the vision. It is where possibility begins. 02 NOTHING OFFERED IN FAITH REMAINS SMALL One gift can become a thousand outcomes! You may never see every life touched by what you begin. What starts in one person’s hands can travel through people, families, systems, and generations, creating outcomes no one person could produce alone. ONE SOURCE The gift begins in one place. Its reach does not have to end there. GIFT 01 A prayer CAN BECOME Courage, clarity, and an open door no strategy could create. GIFT 02 An idea CAN BECOME A pilot, a platform, or an entirely new path of service. GIFT 03 A skill CAN BECOME A system, a standard, and capacity that outlives one person. GIFT 04 A connection CAN BECOME The moment a need, a resource, and the right person finally meet. GIFT 05 Your time CAN BECOME Dignity, relief, companionship, and hope for

domains.description: A free 30 second check for Singapore PRs who are renting. A straight answer on what you can buy and what it will cost.
h1: Can you buy a home in Singapore as a PR?
domains.visibleText: ⌂ ERIN AI · PROPERTY ADVISOR Check If I Can Buy For Singapore PRs who are still renting Can you buy a home in Singapore as a PR? Find out in 30 seconds. Before a single viewing. A straight answer on what you can buy, and what it will cost you. Check If I Can Buy → 30 seconds. Free. What rent costs you $38,400 That is one year of rent at $3,200 a month. It buys you nothing you keep. An example only. Rent for four years at that rate and $153,600 is gone. Check If I Can Buy → 30 seconds. Free. The rules nobody explains Three numbers every PR must know before viewing a single home. 3 yrs as a PR before you can buy an HDB resale flat, if no citizen is buying with you. 5% extra stamp duty on your first home as a PR. CPF can cover it. On a resale you pay cash first and claim it back. 25% of the price up front, on your first home. 5% must be hard cash. The rest can be CPF. Most PRs learn these at the viewing, or at the bank. The check tells you first. Check If I Can Buy → 30 seconds. Free. Sound familiar? Which one is you? “I don’t even know if I am allowed to buy an HDB flat.” “I don’t know how much I need saved. So I keep renting.” “I looked at condos online and gave up. The numbers made no sense.” “Everyone tells me something different.” Check If I Can Buy → 30 seconds. Free. The three mistakes Where PRs lose years, and money. Mistake 1 Renting past the point you could buy. Many PRs cross the 3-year mark and never notice. Every month after that is rent you did not need to pay. Mistake 2 Guessing your budget from the listing price. The price is not the number. Your cash, your CPF, the stamp duty and the loan you can get decide it. Work those out first and the price follows. Mistake 3 Looking at the wrong type of home. Some PRs chase condos when an HDB resale flat was open to them. Others wait for HDB when the rules say they cannot buy one at all. One question settles it. Check If I Can Buy → 30 seconds. Free. How Erin does it The Work-Backwards Method. Most people start with the home. Erin starts with your numbers. Three steps, in this order. 1. Eligibility Which scheme you can buy under. HDB resale, private, or both. Based on your status and who is buying with you. 2. Costs first 5% cash. 20% down. 5% extra stamp duty. Buyer’s Stamp Duty and legal fees. All added up before you look at a price. 3. Price last The loan you qualify for at the 4% test rate sets your ceiling. Now you have a real budget. Now the shortlist makes sense. Check If I Can Buy → 30 seconds. Free. What you get Pass the check, and three things unlock. The PR Home Starter Kit A step-by-step “what to do first” roadmap. A budget guide so you do not over-stretch. A shortlist guide to the right projects and towns for PRs. Your 3-Home Shortlist Three homes matched to your numbers, not to a listing site. Erin keeps 30 more for buyers who are ready to move. A 60-minute planning session Zoom or in person. Your real figures, your options, and the order to do things in. Free. Check If I Can Buy

domains.visibleText: Bitter Blood Synopsis Trailer Gallery Cast & Crew Statement Credits Press Kit A True Jamaican Family Mystery Bitter Blood Two lives betrayed. Two homes divided. One secret buried beneath the current. A Film by Danielle Terrelonge · Narrative Short · Semi-Silent Watch Trailer The Story Scroll Logline In One Sentence A hard-working Jamaican mother leaves her toddler in the care of her husband's mistress, leading to an unspoken tragedy that haunts a family for generations. Drama True Story Psychological Suspense Narrative Short Semi-Silent Film About the Film In the quiet hills of rural Jamaica, some truths are too heavy to speak aloud. Bitter Blood uncovers a dark, generational taboo — the secret lives, second families, and unspoken infidelities that split households and destroy lineages. When Enid leaves her toddler in the hands of her husband's mistress to work the fields, a desperate compromise turns into an unthinkable tragedy. By the time the sun sets, a child is dead in the river, and a family is bound forever by silence, suspicion, and a devastating question that remains unanswered to this day: was it a horrific accident, or an act of cold malice? 01 Generational Silence & Taboo The cultural norm of quiet endurance around infidelity and secret lineages in rural Jamaica. 02 Maternal Grief & Betrayal The devastating intersection of economic necessity, personal sacrifice, and tragic loss. 03 Unanswered History The painful ambiguity of family mysteries that are never fully resolved. Shantaye Brown Cast — "The Mistress" A published author, writer, and biotech professional, Shantaye brought quiet power and depth to one of the film's most complex, unspoken roles. Mario Stanley Cinematography & Technical Collaboration, Emberline Films — Cast "Lascelle" A documentarian and fellow indigenous Jamaican with proud Maroon roots, Mario's technical guidance and steady leadership made this shoot possible under tight constraints. With immeasurable gratitude to Aunt Jennifer ("Auntie Jen") — our family's living encyclopedia, whose courage, honesty, and generosity during a single December drive made this story possible to tell at all. domains.description: Guía de visita gratuita al Paseo de la Costa en Neuquén, junto al Río Limay. Cómo llegar, estacionamiento, servicios, clima en vivo y rutas para recorrer la costanera.
domains.visibleText: Saltar al contenido Paseo de la Costa Inicio Planificá tu visita Cómo llegar Servicios Por estación Rutas Ubicación Preguntas ES EN ES EN Neuquén · Río Limay · Argentina Paseo de la Costa (Neuquén) Donde la ciudad aprende a caminar con el río. Una guía independiente para descubrir Paseo de la Costa: una ribera pública de baja dificultad donde el paisaje, el movimiento y la pausa se encuentran. 4.6 ( 28.845 ) Google Maps Empezá el recorrido Ver ubicación ↘ Ribera del río Limay · Paseo Costero 01 14 km de ribera pública Baja dificultad de senderos Exterior espacio de acceso público 01 Cuaderno de ribera Paseo de la Costa · Neuquén · Provincia de Neuquén · Argentina Un paseo que sigue el curso del Limay. Paseo de la Costa recorre la ribera del río Limay y enlaza distintos tramos de la ciudad de Neuquén. La información pública municipal describe 14 kilómetros de costa, con senderos delimitados, bicisendas, iluminación, miradores, estaciones saludables y zonas para descansar. El trazado tiene baja dificultad y está pensado para la convivencia de peatones y ciclistas. Paseo de la Costa, también conocido como Paseo Costero Río Limay, es el paseo ribereño principal de Neuquén. Se extiende junto al río Limay, en el corazón de la ciudad, y funciona como punto de partida para quienes recorren la región. Ver fuente municipal El agua es paisaje y también condición cambiante: antes de acercarte a la orilla, observá señalización, clima y estado del sector. Nota de cuidado Orientación práctica Planificá una visita a tu ritmo. No hay una única experiencia de paseo: elegí un tramo, dejá margen para detenerte y verificá en el día los servicios puntuales que necesitás. Carta de recorrido · tramos 01—04 Luz, servicios y condiciones del río: verificá en sitio. 38° 58′ S · 68° 03′ O Mejor momento y tiempo sugerido Las primeras horas y el final de la tarde suelen ofrecer luz más suave para caminar y observar el río. Para una primera aproximación, reservá entre 60 y 120 minutos; un recorrido en bicicleta o con pausas puede extenderse. En verano, la exposición al sol y las condiciones del río requieren atención extra. Entrada y costos El paseo se presenta como espacio público al aire libre y no se informa una entrada general. Las actividades, servicios temporales o eventos pueden tener condiciones propias: consultá su organización antes de participar. Cuaderno de ribera Servicios que conviene ubicar Sanitarios Hay baños públicos informados en un tramo del Paseo Costero Río Limay cercano al Club Unipol. Su disponibilidad y horario pueden variar. Estacionamiento Encontrarás sectores de estacionamiento y zonas de parada en distintos accesos. Respetá la señalización y no bloquees circulaciones peatonales ni ciclovías. Comida y descanso Cerca de los accesos urbanos pueden encontrarse opciones de gastronomía y puntos para comprar agua o provisiones. Esta guía no recomienda comercios específicos. ゴッホ、モネ、ルノワール、セザンヌ、クリムトから、北斎、広重まで19人の巨匠。世界中で愛される名画だけを厳選した、みわ文具のアート卓上カレンダー2027。片面は名画を大きく楽しめるアート面、もう片面はたっぷり書き込める実用面の2WAY仕様です。 高級紙ヴァンヌーボ採用｜作品解説書・ミニカレンダー付き｜日本製 アートカレンダー 2027 全41デザイン｜各 ¥1,390（税込）｜Amazonにて販売中 カレンダーのこだわりを見る → ゴッホ モネ ルノワール 葛飾北斎 歌川広重 シスレー ピサロ ドガ ターナー マネ スーラ クリムト ルソー ロートレック ミレー ド・スタール セザンヌ ゴーギャン クレー フィンセント・ファン・ゴッホ Vincent van Gogh（1853–1890） ゴッホのカレンダーを詳しく見る（収録作品・解説）→ ゴッホ 名作選 Vol.1 「ローヌ川の星月夜」「アイリス」「カラスのいる麦畑」など、誰もが知る代表作を13点収録。 ¥1,390 （税込） Amazonで見る 南仏とオーヴェールの田園 Vol.2 「収穫」「オーヴェルの家々」など、南仏の光と田園を描いた風景を集めたセット。 ¥1,390 （税込） Amazonで見る クロード・モネ Claude Monet（1840–1926） モネのカレンダーを詳しく見る（収録作品・解説）→ モネ 代表作選 Vol.1 「睡蓮」「かささぎ」「積みわら」「サン＝ラザール駅」など、印象派の巨匠の代表作を凝縮。 ¥1,390 （税込） Amazonで見る 睡蓮と日本の橋 Vol.2 ジヴェルニーの庭に捧げた晩年の傑作群。睡蓮の世界にひたる一年を。 ¥1,390 （税込） Amazonで見る セーヌと海辺 Vol.3 「プールヴィルの崖の散歩道」「エトルタ」など、水辺の光を描いた風景セット。 ¥1,390 （税込） Amazonで見る 積みわらとポピー、四季の田園 Vol.4 連作「積みわら」とひなげし畑。移ろう季節と光を味わうセット。 ¥1,390 （税込） Amazonで見る ロンドン・ヴェネツィア・旅の風景 Vol.5 霧の国会議事堂、水の都ヴェネツィア。モネの旅の風景を集めたセット。 ¥1,390 （税込） Amazonで見る ピエール＝オーギュスト・ルノワール Pierre-Auguste Renoir（1841–1919） ルノワールのカレンダーを詳しく見る（収録作品・解説）→ ルノワール 代表作選（横）Vol.1 「ムーラン・ド・ラ・ギャレットの舞踏会」「舟遊びの昼食」など、幸福の名場面を13点。 ¥1,390 （税込） Amazonで見る 風景と海辺 Vol.3 サン・マルコ広場、ナポリ湾、南仏の農園。旅と光の風景を集めたセット。 ¥1,390 （税込） Amazonで見る 葛飾北斎 Katsushika Hokusai（1760–1849） 葛飾北斎のカレンダーを詳しく見る（収録作品・解説）→ 北斎 富嶽三十六景 Vol.1 「凱風快晴（赤富士）」「山下白雨」「江戸日本橋」など、富士を描いた代表作を13点。 ¥1,390 （税込） Amazonで見る 富嶽三十六景 続編 Vol.2 「甲州石班沢」「隠田の水車」「五百らかん寺さざゐどう」など、富嶽の名品をさらに13点。 ¥1,390 （税込） Amazonで見る 北斎 花鳥画 Vol.4 「牡丹に蝶」「朝顔に雨蛙」「芥子」など、北斎の観察眼が光る花鳥の小品を集めたセット。 ¥1,390 （税込） Amazonで見る 歌川広重 Utagawa Hiroshige（1797–1858） 歌川広重のカレンダーを詳しく見る（収録作品・解説）→ 東海道五十三次 Vol.2 「蒲原 夜之雪」「庄野 白雨」「箱根 湖水図」など、旅情あふれる宿場の風景を13点。 ¥1,390 （税込） Amazonで見る 近江八景と雪月花 Vol.3 近江八景の「唐崎夜雨」「石山秋月」ほか、雪・月・花の名所を描いた情緒あふれるセット。 ¥1,390 （税込） Amazonで見る アルフレッド・シスレー Alfred Sisley（1839–1899） シスレーのカレンダーを詳しく見る（収録作品・解説）→ シスレー 代表作選 Vol.1 「ポール＝マルリーの洪水」「ポール＝マルリーの洪水と小舟」「ヴィルヌーヴ＝ラ＝ガレンヌの橋」など、13点を収録したセット。 ¥1,390 （税込） Amazonで見る ロワン川とモレの四季 Vol.2 「サン＝マメス、6月の陽光」「ロワン運河」「ロワン川の岸辺、秋の効果」など、13点を収録したセット。 ¥1,390 （税込） Amazonで見る セーヌと村の道 Vol.3 「ポール＝マルリーのセーヌ川、砂の山」「ブージヴァル近くのセーヌ川」「サン＝クルー近くのセーヌ川」など、13点を収録したセット。 ¥1,390 （税込） Amazonで見る カミーユ・ピサロ Camille Pissarro（1830–1903） ピサロのカレンダーを詳しく見る（収録作品・解説）→ ピサロ 代表作選 Vol.1 「モンマルトル大通り、春」「モンマルトル大通り、冬の朝」「イタリアン大通り、朝の陽光」など、13点を収録したセット。 ¥1,390 （税込） Amazonで見る パリの街と田園 Vol.2 Degas（1834–1917） ドガのカレンダーを詳しく見る（収録作品・解説）→ ドガ 代表作選（バレエ） Vol.1 「ダンス教室」「四人の踊り子」「舞台稽古」など、13点を収録したセット。 ¥1,390 （税込） Amazonで見る 競馬と風景 Vol.2 「田舎の競馬場で」「競馬」「レースの前」など、13点を収録したセット。 ¥1,390 （税込） Amazonで見る J. domains.description: VPS で AI エージェントとセルフホストを動かすエンジニアの実践記録
domains.visibleText: VPS Notes VPS セルフホスト キャリア About VPS Notes VPS で AI エージェントとセルフホストを動かすエンジニアの実践記録 VPS VPS の選び方・初期設定・セキュリティ・比較 セルフホスト n8n・Immich・Ollama など自分で動かす キャリア フリーランスの単価・エージェント・転職 最新記事 Hermes Agent を Claude Code だけで自作する: 記憶が育つ常駐エージェント「iris」を VPS に置く VPS に常駐する Claude Code の Remote Control を自分専用エージェントにしました。memory・skills・notes の 3 層で学んだことを記憶し、cron で週次レビュー、結果は Telegram へ。常駐プロセス追加なし、API 課金なし。Hermes との使い分けも。 2026-09-26 VPS Claude Code の CLAUDE.md と memory の書き方: 置き場所、@import、auto memory との違い、記憶を育てる 5 つのルール CLAUDE.md の置き場所と読み込み順、@import の仕様、auto memory との違いを公式ドキュメントで整理し、VPS の常駐エージェントで 3 日回して分かった「記憶が育つ書き方」をまとめました。skill が自分で直った実例と、間違いを覚えたときの直し方まで。 2026-09-26 VPS Claude Code のスキルの作り方: SKILL.md の書き方と、常駐エージェントの手順書を移して分かった本当の違い Claude Code のスキル (SKILL.md) の置き場所、frontmatter、呼ばれる仕組みを公式ドキュメントで整理し、VPS の常駐エージェントの手順書 3 つを移して前後を比べました。選ばれる精度とコストはほぼ同じ。差が出たのは「会話の途中で増えたスキル」でした。 2026-09-26 VPS Claude で Gmail を整理する: コネクタでできること・できないこと、常駐エージェントに任せて分かった 3 つの落とし穴 Claude の Gmail コネクタで、広告メールの仕分け、削除、「なぜ受信トレイにない?」の調査を、VPS の常駐エージェントにやらせました。できること (検索・下書き・送信・ラベル) とできないこと (一括削除、履歴の調査)、送信の承認と権限の注意まで。 2026-09-26 VPS EDINET API の使い方: API キーの取得から Python で有報と財務データ (XBRL) を取るまで EDINET API v2 で有価証券報告書を取得し、XBRL から売上高や営業利益を取り出すまでを、動くコードつきで解説します。キーが無効でも 200 が返る罠、単体決算・IFRS・銀行の「経常収益」など、8,480 本を取り込んで分かった XBRL の癖も。 2026-09-23 セルフホスト 有価証券報告書を AI (Claude Code) で分析する: EDINET API で本文を取り、前年からの変化を拾う 有報の「事業等のリスク」と「経営者による分析 (MD&A)」を 2 期分、Claude Code に読ませて、前年から変わった点を抜き出しました。SUBARU で試すと 82 秒で 10 項目、引用 10 文はすべて原文に実在。本文を XBRL の TextBlock で切り出す方法と、つまずいた点まで。 2026-09-23 セルフホスト フリーランスエンジニアのエージェント比較: マージン・支払いサイト・週 3 案件・保障で 5 社を選び分ける レバテックフリーランス、ITプロパートナーズ、Midworks、ギークスジョブ、PE-BANK を、公式サイトで確認できた支払いサイト、保障、週 2〜3 日案件、福利厚生で比べました。面談で聞くべきこと、複数登録の使い方、SES から抜けたい人向けの転職エージェントも。 2026-09-23 キャリア フリーランスエンジニアの単価相場と手取り: 月 70 万の案件で手元にいくら残るか、会社員の年収と正しく比べる フリーランス PM を 2 年やって会社員に戻った立場から、単価の相場 (経験年数・領域・稼働日数別)、手取りの計算式、経費と税金、会社員の年収との換算方法、「やめとけ」と言われる理由をまとめました。 2026-09-23 キャリア Immich を 4GB の VPS で動かす: Google フォトから移行して、機械学習と日本語検索まで実測 Google フォト代替の Immich v3 を 4GB の VPS に Docker で立て、Google Takeout から immich-go で移行し、Pixel から自動バックアップするまでを実機で試しました。機械学習なし・あり・多言語モデルのメモリ実測と、日本語で検索できるようにする設定まで。 2026-09-23 セルフホスト Hermes Agent を VPS で動かす: 何ができるか、必要スペック、料金、Telegram から使うまで Nous Research の Hermes Agent を 4GB の VPS に入れ、Claude をバックエンドに Telegram から VPS を操作するまでを実機で確認しました。インストール、gateway の常駐、memory と cron の実際の挙動、1 回あたりのトークン消費、つまずいた点まで。 2026-09-21 セルフホスト n8n を VPS にセルフホストして、Claude と MCP で繋ぐ (Docker Compose + Tailscale) 自動化ツール n8n を月 2,000 円台の VPS に Docker で立て、Tailscale 経由で HTTPS のままスマホから使えるようにします。Claude を挟んだワークフローの作り方と、n8n を MCP サーバーにして Claude Code から呼ぶ手順まで。 2026-09-20 セルフホスト Ollama を GPU なしの VPS で動かす実測: 何 B のモデルまで実用か、n8n から呼ぶまで 国内 VPS は GPU がありません。それでも Ollama で小さなオープン LLM を CPU で動かし、常駐の要約・分類・ボットに使えるかを 4GB / 8GB で実測しました。インストール、Tailscale 内への公開、OpenAI 互換 API、n8n からの呼び出しまで。 2026-09-20 セルフホスト Claude Code を VPS Replace fragile WhatsApp threads and messy spreadsheets with signed QR passes and a door that checks in guests instantly — online or off. h1: Когато стандартният софтуер не пасва, ние изграждаме решението.
domains.visibleText: Прескочи към съдържанието DEPLOEE Услуги Избрани проекти Консултация За нас Контакт EN Вход Запазете разговор Deploee — Boutique Software Studio Когато стандартният софтуер не пасва, ние изграждаме решението. Deploee е бутик, founder-led компания за разработка на софтуер. Помагаме на бизнеси с нестандартни оперативни и технически предизвикателства — чрез tailored софтуер, smart архитектура и, когато е необходимо, хардуерно-интегрирани решения. Запазете разговор Вижте проектите Малък founder-led екип. Бързи решения. Практични решения. Sofia, Bulgaria Deploee Ltd. Custom Business Software ERP-like Systems B2B Platforms Process Automation Technical Consulting Software + Hardware Solutions Embedded Firmware SaaS Architecture Custom Business Software ERP-like Systems B2B Platforms Process Automation Technical Consulting Software + Hardware Solutions Embedded Firmware SaaS Architecture Доверен от бизнеси, нуждаещи се от повече от стандартен софтуер 20 + Години технически опит 50 + Персонализирани системи доставени EU US + Клиенти в Европа и САЩ ∞ От embedded firmware до SaaS Abritus Soft Кога се обръщат към нас Повечето клиенти се свързват с нас когато: Ако вашият бизнес проблем е необичаен, domain-специфичен или технически комплексен — точно тук сме най-полезни. Стандартният софтуер не пасва Вашият workflow е твърде специфичен — готовите решения изискват компромиси, които излизат скъпо оперативно. Персонализацията стана скъпа Разходите за надграждане на съществуващи платформи нарастват, но резултатите остават ограничени от generic архитектура. Инструментите не говорят помежду си Операциите разчитат на разкачени системи, ръчни процеси и spreadsheets, вместо на интегрирана екосистема. Нуждаете се от software + hardware Проблемът надхвърля чистия софтуер — нужна е интеграция с устройства, сензори или оперативна инфраструктура. Нуждаете се от senior преценка Не сте сигурни кое е правилното техническо решение — и не искате да инвестирате в грешното направление. Операциите са твърде специфични Бизнесът ви работи в нишова индустрия или с уникални процеси, за които не съществуват готови инструменти. Повече от разработка Правим повече от изграждане на софтуер. Помагаме на клиентите да дефинират правилното решение преди да бъде написан и ред код. domains.description: Punjabi news, information and entertainment from Sidak Official.
domains.visibleText: ਹੱਕ ਸੱਚ ਦੀ ਆਵਾਜ਼ • Sidak Official Sidak Official ਹੱਕ ਸੱਚ ਦੀ ਆਵਾਜ਼ Owner login ਮੁੱਖ ਖ਼ਬਰਾਂ ਬੈਲਜੀਅਮ ਪੰਜਾਬ ਭਾਰਤ ਯੂਰਪ ਵਿਦੇਸ਼ ਮਨੋਰੰਜਨ ਕਵਿਤਾਵਾਂ ਤੇ ਗੀਤ ਵੀਡੀਓ ਸਾਡੇ ਬਾਰੇ ਸੰਪਰਕ YouTube Facebook TikTok Instagram Call Now Chat SIDAK OFFICIAL PRESENTS ਹੱਕ ਸੱਚ ਦੀ ਆਵਾਜ਼ SIDAK VIDEO ਵੀਡੀਓ ਵਿੱਚ ਹਰ ਗੱਲ, ਸਿੱਧੀ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਤੱਕ। ਬੈਲਜੀਅਮ, ਪੰਜਾਬ ਤੇ ਭਾਰਤ ਦੀਆਂ ਨਵੀਆਂ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਦੇ ਮੁੱਦੇ ਹੁਣ ਵੀਡੀਓ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੀ ਵੇਖੋ। Sidak Official YouTube → ਤਾਜ਼ਾ ਖ਼ਬਰਾਂ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਲਈ ਕੰਮ ਦੀ ਗੱਲ ਖ਼ਬਰ ਉੱਤੇ ਦਬਾ ਕੇ ਪੂਰੀ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਪੜ੍ਹੋ। ਬੈਲਜੀਅਮ Sint-Truiden ਵਿੱਚ Punjabi/Indian ਕਾਰੋਬਾਰੀਆਂ ਨੇ burgemeester ਅੱਗੇ ਰੱਖੀਆਂ ਆਪਣੀਆਂ ਮੁਸ਼ਕਲਾਂ, Union ਬਣਾਉਣ ’ਤੇ ਗੱਲਬਾਤ Councillor Pritty Kaur Bath ਦੀ ਪਹਿਲਕਦਮੀ ਨਾਲ Sint-Truiden ਦੇ ਪੰਜਾਬੀ/ਭਾਰਤੀ ਕਾਰੋਬਾਰੀਆਂ ਦੀ burgemeester Ludwig Vandenhove ਨਾਲ ਅਹਿਮ ਮੀਟਿੰਗ ਹੋਈ। ਕਾਰੋਬਾਰੀਆਂ ਨਾਲ ਜੁੜੀਆਂ ਮੁਸ਼ਕਲਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਮਸਲਿਆਂ ’ਤੇ ਸਿੱਧੀ ਗੱਲਬਾਤ ਹੋਈ ਅਤੇ Union ਬਣਾਉਣ ਸਮੇਤ ਕਈ ਅਹਿਮ ਮੁੱਦੇ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ਗਏ। ਮੀਟਿੰਗ ਵਿੱਚ ਕੀ ਹੋਇਆ? …ਪੜ੍ਹੋ ਪੂਰੀ ਖ਼ਬਰ। ਪੂਰੀ ਖ਼ਬਰ ਖੋਲ੍ਹੋ → ਬੈਲਜੀਅਮ Belgium ਵਿੱਚ ਕੁਝ ਘਟਨਾਵਾਂ ਪਿੱਛੇ ਰੂਸ ਦੇ ਸੰਕੇਤ: ਰੱਖਿਆ ਮੰਤਰੀ ਦਾ ਦਾਅਵਾ ਬੈਲਜੀਅਮ, 24 ਸਤੰਬਰ (ਪਰਮਜੀਤ ਸਿੰਘ ਕੰਗ) - Belgium ਦੇ ਰੱਖਿਆ ਮੰਤਰੀ Theo Francken ਨੇ ਕਿਹਾ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਦੇਸ਼ ਵਿੱਚ ਹੋਈਆਂ ਕੁਝ ਸ਼ੱਕੀ ਘਟਨਾਵਾਂ ਪਿੱਛੇ ਰੂਸ ਦੀ ਭੂਮਿਕਾ ਹੋਣ ਦੇ “ਮਜ਼ਬੂਤ ਸੰਕੇਤ” ਮਿਲੇ ਹਨ। ਮੰਤਰੀ ਮੁਤਾਬਕ ਸੁਰੱਖਿਆ ਸੇਵਾਵਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਰੱਖਿਆ ਵਿਭਾਗ ਨੇ ਦਰਜਨਾਂ ਘਟਨਾਵਾਂ ਦੀ ਜਾਂਚ ਕੀਤੀ ਹੈ। ਪੂਰੀ ਖ਼ਬਰ ਖੋਲ੍ਹੋ → ਪੰਜਾਬ ਪੰਜਾਬ ਵਿੱਚ ਪਰਾਲੀ ਨਾ ਸਾੜਨ ਲਈ 1.25 ਲੱਖ ਮਸ਼ੀਨਾਂ ਤਿਆਰ ਪੰਜਾਬ, 24 ਸਤੰਬਰ (ਪਰਮਜੀਤ ਸਿੰਘ ਕੰਗ) - ਪੰਜਾਬ ਸਰਕਾਰ ਨੇ ਇਸ ਸਾਲ ਪਰਾਲੀ ਸਾੜਨ ਦੀ ਸਮੱਸਿਆ ਘਟਾਉਣ ਲਈ ਲਗਭਗ 1.25 ਲੱਖ crop-residue management ਮਸ਼ੀਨਾਂ ਤਿਆਰ ਹੋਣ ਦਾ ਦਾਅਵਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਹੈ। ਇਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ Super Seeder, baler ਅਤੇ ਹੋਰ ਮਸ਼ੀਨਾਂ ਸ਼ਾਮਲ ਹਨ। ਪੂਰੀ ਖ਼ਬਰ ਖੋਲ੍ਹੋ → ਬੈਲਜੀਅਮ Sint-Truiden ਵਿੱਚ Day Shops, Night Shops, Car Washes ਅਤੇ Indian/Punjabi Restaurants ਦੇ ਮਾਲਕਾਂ ਲਈ ਅਹਿਮ ਮੀਟਿੰਗ 23 ਸਤੰਬਰ ਬੁੱਧਵਾਰ ਨੂੰ ਸ਼ਾਮ 7:30 ਵਜੇ Sint-Truiden ਵਿੱਚ Day Shops, Night Shops, Car Washes ਅਤੇ Indian/Punjabi Restaurants ਦੇ ਮਾਲਕਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਸ਼ਹਿਰ ਪ੍ਰਸ਼ਾਸਨ ਵਿਚਕਾਰ ਇੱਕ ਅਹਿਮ ਮੀਟਿੰਗ ਰੱਖੀ ਗਈ ਹੈ। ਪੂਰੀ ਖ਼ਬਰ ਖੋਲ੍ਹੋ → ਬੈਲਜੀਅਮ Sint-Truiden ਵਿੱਚ ਪਹਿਲੀ ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਜੰਗ ਦੇ ਸਿੱਖ ਸ਼ਹੀਦਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਸ਼ਰਧਾਂਜਲੀ, ਵੱਡੀ ਗਿਣਤੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਸੰਗਤ ਨੇ ਭਰੀ ਹਾਜ਼ਰੀ (Sint-Truiden, Belgium), 20 ਸਤੰਬਰ (ਪਰਮਜੀਤ ਸਿੰਘ ਕੰਗ): ਬੈਲਜੀਅਮ ਦੇ Sint-Truiden ਵਿਖੇ ਪਹਿਲੀ ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਜੰਗ ਦੌਰਾਨ ਯੂਰਪ ਦੀ ਧਰਤੀ ਉੱਤੇ ਲੜਦਿਆਂ ਸ਼ਹੀਦ ਹੋਏ ਸਿੱਖ ਸੈਨਿਕਾਂ ਦੀ ਯਾਦ ਵਿੱਚ ਭਾਵਪੂਰਣ ਸ਼ਰਧਾਂਜਲੀ ਸਮਾਗਮ ਕਰਵਾਇਆ ਗਿਆ। ਪੂਰੀ ਖ਼ਬਰ ਖੋਲ੍ਹੋ → ਬੈਲਜੀਅਮ ਨੀਲੇ ਕੂੜੇ ਦੇ ਬੈਗ ਵਿੱਚ ਗਲਤ ਸਮਾਨ ਪਾਉਣ ਨਾਲ €24 ਮਿਲੀਅਨ ਦਾ ਖ਼ਰਚਾ Belgium ਦੇ Flanders ਇਲਾਕੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਨੀਲੇ ਰੰਗ ਦੇ PMD ਕੂੜੇ ਵਾਲੇ ਬੈਗਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਬਹੁਤ ਲੋਕ ਗਲਤ ਸਮਾਨ ਪਾ ਰਹੇ ਹਨ। PMD ਦਾ ਮਤਲਬ ਹੈ plastic ਦੀਆਂ ਖਾਲੀ packaging, metal ਦੇ ਡੱਬੇ ਅਤੇ drinks ਦੇ cartons। ਪੂਰੀ ਖ਼ਬਰ ਖੋਲ੍ਹੋ → ਬੈਲਜੀਅਮ Antwerp Port ਵਿੱਚ ਸਾਬਣ ਦੀਆਂ ਬੋਤਲਾਂ ਅੰਦਰ ਤਰਲ cocaine ਬਰਾਮਦ Antwerp ਬੰਦਰਗਾਹ ’ਤੇ customs ਨੇ Colombia ਤੋਂ ਆਏ ਇੱਕ ਸ਼ੱਕੀ container ਦੀ ਜਾਂਚ ਕਰਕੇ ਸਾਬਣ ਦੀਆਂ ਬੋਤਲਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਲੁਕਾਈ ਤਰਲ cocaine ਬਰਾਮਦ ਕੀਤੀ ਹੈ। ਪੂਰੀ ਖ਼ਬਰ ਖੋਲ੍ਹੋ → ਮਨੋਰੰਜਨ Sidak Official ਦੀ ਨਵੀਂ Photo ਪੂਰੀ ਖ਼ਬਰ ਖੋਲ੍ਹੋ → ਪੰਜਾਬ ਜੱਗੀ ਜੌਹਲ ਦੇ ਖੋਹੇ 9 ਸਾਲ—ਦੋਸ਼ ਸਾਬਤ ਨਹੀਂ, ਫਿਰ ਇਨਸਾਫ਼ ਕਿੱਥੇ? domains.description: Camoufy is a local antidetect browser and profile manager for Windows, built on Camoufox. Stable fingerprints, a proxy or Tor per profile, no cloud.
h1: The antidetect browser that keeps everything on your PC.
domains.visibleText: Camoufy Use cases Features Docs Changelog Contact Download The antidetect browser that keeps everything on your PC. Hundreds of isolated Camoufox profiles with stable fingerprints and their own proxies. No account, no cloud. Download Try the demo Camoufox engine Firefox with fingerprint spoofing built into the C++ code Local by design Profiles, cookies and proxy passwords never leave your disk Scriptable Local HTTP API and a Python client for Playwright Windows 10 and 11 Portable: unzip and run, no installer Camoufy The demo is the real Camoufy interface and needs a wider screen. Open it full screen This is the actual Camoufy interface running on made-up data. Start and stop profiles, open the editor, switch pages. Nothing you do here leaves your browser. Use cases One tool for every account you run. Ads and affiliate Marketplaces Social media Scraping and automation QA and ad checks Ad accounts that never share a device Each ad account gets its own fingerprint and its own residential IP. When a platform asks questions, rotate that profile's session with one click. Facebook Ads Google Ads TikTok Ads Bing Ads From zip file to first profile. Download and unzip Put the folder anywhere, even on a USB drive. There is nothing to install. Install the engine On the Engine page, pick a Camoufox release from GitHub. About 470 MB, once. Create profiles Paste your proxy list, create a profile per account and press Start. Fingerprints People don't change their graphics card between visits. A profile gets one 64-bit seed. Screen, cores, fonts and GPU are derived from it once and stay frozen. Built from real browsers. Seeds pick from 312 presets captured from real Firefox installs on Windows, macOS and Linux. Geo follows the exit IP. Timezone, locale and the WebRTC address come from where the proxy really exits. Checked on every start. Each profile opens a page that compares what the browser reports with what its fingerprint promises. seed 2718281828 launch 1 Launch again New seed A simplified illustration. Launch again: a new session, the same values. A profile manager sized for hundreds of accounts. A proxy per profile, with sticky sessions HTTP, HTTPS or SOCKS5 with login. Put {session} into a residential provider's login and each profile keeps its own exit IP ( sticky sessions ). One click rotates it. Or Tor, one circuit each Every Tor profile starts its own tor.exe. Pick the exit country. On networks that block Tor, bridges get it through. de nl se gb us ch An add-on library Install from addons.mozilla.org once, turn it on per profile, update it with one click. Sessions that travel Import cookies from another browser. Export a profile with its fingerprint and add-ons, open it on another PC. Engine versions side by side Install Camoufox releases from GitHub, switch between them, remove old ones. Profiles stay untouched. Search, tag and act in bulk Filter by tag, status or proxy. This is where you get ready. Meet BOB! Your Next-Gen AI Colleague. Built for audit readiness. With you for getting the work done. FOLLOW THE RECORD Standards & frameworks we help you prepare for ISO/IEC 27001 SOC 2 NIST Cybersecurity Framework PCI DSS GDPR India DPDP regime ISO/IEC 42001 View all 40 → ONE CONTINUOUS CHAIN OF PROOF BE → OPERATE → BECOME 01 BE REQUIREMENT Know what must be demonstrated. A scoped requirement starts the record. Choose a framework version, define applicability and connect your organization’s control. ILLUSTRATIVE RECORD · 01 PR.AA · Identity management & access Scope recorded · Mapping requires human review 02 OPERATE EVIDENCE Give every claim a source. Attach private evidence to the control. Preserve who uploaded it, when it was collected and which version supports the claim. ILLUSTRATIVE RECORD · 02 Privileged access review.pdf Private file · SHA-256 recorded · Review date retained 03 OPERATE VERIFICATION Inspect the proof. Record the decision. A person reviews coverage and context. Deterministic checks evaluate freshness, mappings and findings. AI suggestions do not establish readiness. ILLUSTRATIVE RECORD · 03 Control + evidence → explicit human review Accepted / rejected · Rationale · Reviewer · Timestamp 04 OPERATE GAP Make the missing piece visible. An open finding remains visible even when other evidence looks complete. Describe the issue, its severity and the requirement it affects. ILLUSTRATIVE RECORD · 04 Privileged-account review is incomplete Open finding → readiness blocked 05 OPERATE REMEDIATION Assign the work. Ask for proof. Give the action an owner, a due date and an expected evidence outcome. Completing a task is not the same as resolving a finding. ILLUSTRATIVE RECORD · 05 Complete the account review and submit the record Proof submitted → separate review required 06 BECOME READINESS Bring a record you can explain. Trace each readiness state back to a scoped requirement, reviewed mapping and current evidence. Choose exactly what to release to your independent auditor. ILLUSTRATIVE RECORD · 06 Requirement → control → evidence → review Explicit release · Fixed manifest · Expiry & revocation AI reasons. Deterministic checks prove. No AI service is connected. domains.visibleText: +03-8883 6468 [email protected] Putrajaya, Malaysia Laman Utama Sejarah Pencapaian Program Kebolehpasaran PROTÉGÉ – RTW Ready To Work Keusahawanan JAGUH ★ Keusahawanan Nasional 2026 N-GENE New Gen Entrepreneur Bootcamp SPACE Program Usahawan Perantis Asas PUSh Program Usahawan Siswazah SPACE – PPS Pembangunan Produk & Servis GRACE Program TVET Keusahawanan SPTVET B40 Pensijilan Profesional B40 TVET ROAD Kembara Kerjaya PROTÉGÉ JJP Jom Jumpa PROTÉGÉ PANDU Anjakan Minda Keusahawanan Hubungi Kami Log Masuk Daftar Sekarang Inisiatif KUSKOP Bina Masa Depan Kerjaya & Keusahawanan Anda PROTÉGÉ adalah program latihan profesional di bawah Kementerian Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi (KUSKOP) yang menyediakan pendedahan industri sebenar dan kemahiran keusahawanan untuk graduan Malaysia. Terokai Program Mengenai PROTÉGÉ Professional Training & Education for Growing Entrepreneurs Melaksanakan inisiatif-inisiatif untuk meningkatkan potensi kebolehpasaran serta memupuk kemahiran keusahawanan dalam kalangan graduan. Bersama Membangunkan Modal Insan Berkualiti Latar Belakang Inisiatif Nasional di Bawah KUSKOP Professional Training and Education for Growing Entrepreneurs (PROTÉGÉ) merupakan satu Unit di bawah Kementerian Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi (KUSKOP) . Selaras dengan Dasar Keusahawanan Nasional (DKN) 2030 melalui Teras 1: Membudayakan Keusahawanan Dalam Segenap Lapisan Masyarakat , PROTÉGÉ melaksanakan inisiatif-inisiatif untuk meningkatkan potensi kebolehpasaran dan kemahiran keusahawanan dalam kalangan graduan menganggur dan terbuka kepada pelbagai bidang pengajian. Latihan Berstruktur Elaun Bulanan Mentor Profesional Sijil Pengiktirafan Lihat Pencapaian DKN 2030 Penjajaran Dasar Dasar Keusahawanan Nasional 2030 Teras 1 Membudayakan keusahawanan dalam segenap lapisan masyarakat PROTÉGÉ menyumbang secara langsung kepada agenda nasional dengan memupuk minda keusahawanan dalam kalangan graduan Malaysia, menyediakan latihan peningkatan kemahiran dan industri kepada pekerja dan graduan melalui pelaksanaan program-program berimpak tinggi. Visi Melahirkan modal insan graduan yang kompeten, berdaya saing dan berinovasi selaras dengan keperluan industri serta menjadi usahawan berdaya tahan yang menyumbang kepada pembangunan ekonomi negara. Misi Meningkatkan kebolehpasaran graduan melalui penempatan latihan kerjaya bersama industri. Memupuk kemahiran keusahawanan dalam kalangan graduan dan belia Malaysia. Mewujudkan ekosistem keusahawanan yang mampan melalui kerjasama strategik bersama agensi, institusi pengajian tinggi dan industri. Kelebihan PROTÉGÉ Mengapa Pilih PROTÉGÉ? Program komprehensif yang direka untuk melahirkan graduan berdaya saing dan usahawan berjaya Kerjaya, Keusahawanan & Komuniti Membangunkan generasi graduan Malaysia yang berdaya saing. 正式拍摄时剧组换成了特制牙托，比棉花稳定得多，说台词也不容易掉出来。 这个造型并非原著要求，小说里只写了维托“脸型宽大”，并没有强调腮部。 导演科波拉最初并不赞成，看完试镜片段之后才改变了主意。 这一造型后来成了黑帮片“大佬脸”的模板，被大量同类作品模仿沿用。 《泰坦尼克号》结尾，杰克真的没法爬上那块门板吗？ 导演卡梅隆多次说明，门板尺寸参照真实残骸设计，浮力在物理上确实有限。 2012 年一档科普节目做过实验，结论是两人同时上板会导致门板下沉。 2022 年卡梅隆又做了一次实验，证明存在让两人都活下来的办法，但他坚持剧情需要这个结局。 剧本中杰克的死亡是推动露丝完成转变的关键节点，并非偶然安排。 那块门板道具后来被拍卖，成为影史上辨识度最高的道具之一。 张国荣在《霸王别姬》里的京剧身段是替身完成的吗？ 大部分近景与身段由张国荣本人完成，他提前数月到北京学习京剧基本功。 高难度的翻扑、下腰等动作由专业京剧演员担任替身完成。 他的京剧化妆师后来回忆，张国荣练功时常常汗透衣衫，收工后还继续加练。 片中程蝶衣的唱段由京剧演员温如华配音，并非张国荣原声。 陈凯歌曾表示，张国荣的眼神与手部姿态是替身无法替代的部分。 《千与千寻》里的无脸男，原型到底是什么？ 宫崎骏在访谈中提到，无脸男象征的是“无法融入集体、找不到归属的人”。 也有说法认为它参考了日本民间传说里的“客人神”，但这一说法未获主创确认。 无脸男的形象最初只是一张草图，线条极简，面具是后来才加上去的。 它在澡堂里疯狂撒金子的段落，被普遍认为影射泡沫经济时代的暴发户心态。 这个角色几乎没有台词，情绪全靠气声与肢体动作传达，反而更有压迫感。 《肖申克的救赎》里那把锤子，真的藏在圣经里吗？ 原著小说里，安迪的锤子藏在被挖空书页的圣经中，电影保留了这个设定。 道具组专门做了一本中间挖空的圣经，书脊上印着编号“Dufresne 37946”。 影片中打开圣经的那一页正好是《出埃及记》，内容与“救赎”主题形成呼应。 主演蒂姆·罗宾斯拍完把道具带回了家，后来才发现书里夹着剧组留下的签名页。 现实中用一把小锤子挖通混凝土墙，影迷实测认为至少需要二十年，而非影片里的十九年。 《流浪地球》里的行星发动机，设定参考了什么？ 原著小说中发动机分为“地球派”与“飞船派”两种方案，电影主要呈现前者。 美术团队参考了重工业厂区、火箭喷口与巨型水坝的造型语言来构建外形。 发动机高度设定为一万一千米，底座直径约六十公里，这些数字在片中有明确交代。 导演郭帆提到，剧组绘制了大量结构草图，尽量让机械看起来符合工程逻辑。 发动机“转向”的概念，来自原著中利用引力弹弓效应改变轨道的设想。 留言评论 Add a rainy season that runs May through October, near-daily summer sea-breeze thunderstorms, and the fact that almost every Tampa home is built slab-on-grade with nowhere for water to go but straight into living space, and you get a city where water damage isn't a rare emergency — it's a recurring risk. We're a Tampa-based water damage restoration crew that responds 24/7 to storm flooding, burst pipes, roof leaks, and sewage backups anywhere in the Tampa Bay area. Every job follows IICRC S500 drying and water-category protocols, with moisture readings documented from first extraction to final dry-standard confirmation — not a visual guess that a room "looks dry." Because mold can start colonizing wet materials in Tampa's humidity within 24 to 48 hours, speed matters as much as technique. We show up fast, extract water immediately, and get industrial drying equipment running before a water loss has a chance to become a mold problem too. Why

domains.title: Anna Terry | Movement Health & Holistic Performance
domains.description: Anna Terry, Movement Health Specialist and Holistic Performance Coach. Remote coaching for people who want to keep moving well and feel like themselves.
domains.visibleText: Anna Terry Movement Health Specialist + Holistic Performance Coach Get unstuck. Find your flow. Remote coaching for people who want to keep moving well, cut through the noise, and feel like themselves again. Who this is for Active people who want to feel good in their bodies and keep doing the things they love. That is the whole requirement. A few of my clients are competitive athletes. Most are not. What they have in common is that they are capable, carrying a lot, getting conflicting advice from every direction, and slowly losing the thread on themselves. Someone in their fifties whose back went out again and cannot tell whether it is the desk, the golf swing, or the year they have been having. A parent who is carrying everyone else's schedule in their shoulders and has not had a plan of their own in years. An athlete who keeps getting hurt in the same place and has been told it is just tight, when the pattern started somewhere else entirely. Anyone whose body has started sending signals they do not know how to read. If none of those is quite you and you still want to move well and feel like yourself, you are in the right place. How I work Good care works. What it cannot do is follow you into Tuesday afternoon. Most people spend far more hours between appointments than in them, and that gap is where I work. There is more health information available than ever and less clarity than ever. Conflicting advice, a care team that does not talk to each other, aches that come and go, and a nervous system that has been running hot for years. Most of what gets sold to you treats one part, and none of it was built for your body, your history, or your life. My work is reading the whole picture at once. Posture, breath, biomechanics, injury history, stress patterns, and fascia. Your body holds stress in specific places, and those places are connected. The thing that hurts is usually not the thing causing it. A jaw you clench at night shows up in a hip. A ribcage that has not moved fully in years shows up as a neck that will not settle. I find the one or two things that actually move everything else, and help you navigate the rest so it stays manageable. This is coaching and education. It works alongside the people already on your team. If you have a physician, physical therapist, or athletic trainer you trust, keep them. I do not manage your care or speak to your providers. I give you the questions to ask and the language to use so you walk into those rooms prepared. Working together Monthly coaching Two sessions a month plus messaging in between. For people carrying a lot at once who want someone in their corner who knows the whole picture. We find where you are holding, what it is connected to, and which one or two things actually change it. We work on movement, breath, recovery, and the daily patterns that either hold you together or wear you down. domains.title: Tally — never bring up money in session again
domains.description: Scheduling and balances for private-pay counseling practices. Clients see what they owe in their own portal, so the session stays about the work.
h1: Never bring up money in session again.
domains.visibleText: Early access Sign in For private-pay counseling practices Never bring up money in session again. Tally keeps track of what each client owes and shows it to them in their own portal — so the fifty minutes stay about the work, not about an unpaid balance. Get early access $29.99 a therapist — capped at $99.99 for the whole office. You trained to be a therapist. Then you became the billing department. A client is three sessions behind. You have two options, and you already know both of them. Spend part of the hour on it — the hour they came to you for something else entirely — or let it slide again and carry it yourself. Neither one is good. The first costs the session; the second costs you. And the longer it goes, the more awkward the conversation gets for both of you. The fix isn't a better script. It's making the balance something your client can already see, so nobody has to raise it. How it works 01 They see their own balance Every client gets a portal with their past visits, what's been paid, and what's outstanding. No invoice to chase down, no email to send, no reason to bring it up in the room. 02 You see who's behind One screen: every client, their next session, and what they owe. You know before they walk in, instead of finding out three months later. 03 Booking that fits how you work Book a standing slot — same time, weekly or every other week, for a set number of sessions. Skip a week, move one session, or move the whole slot. It asks which you meant. Pricing $29.99 a therapist. Never more than $99.99. One price, everything included — no tiers to compare and no features held back for a plan above yours. A solo practice pays $29.99 a month. A group practice pays $29.99 each until the bill hits $99.99, and then it stops. Four therapists or twelve, $99.99 is the ceiling for the whole office. That ceiling is the part worth reading twice. Practice management software is priced per clinician and keeps climbing — at $49 to $99 each, a four-person practice is paying two to four hundred dollars a month. Here it stops at one hundred. When a client pays for a session through Tally, they pay a flat $5 alongside it — itemized, visible before they pay, the same amount every time. It doesn't come out of your fee. You keep your full rate, including the rates you set low on purpose. And a client who's short this week can split a session into payments instead of quietly falling behind. That's the same problem as the balance nobody wants to raise, caught one step earlier — they choose a smaller payment rather than choosing to say nothing. Your practice pays $29.99 per therapist / month Capped at $99.99 for the whole office, however many of you there are. Your client pays $5 per session Shown as its own line before they pay. Splittable into instalments. Where this actually is Tally is being built right now, by one person, in the open. Get a Free Estimate Get a Free Estimate 863-270-7792 Pool Remodeling for Polk County Homes A pool remodel can address worn finishes, aging tile, deteriorated decking, outdated equipment, or a backyard that no longer works the way you want it to. Polk County Pool Remodeling provides services for homeowners who want to improve the appearance, function, and overall usability of their swimming pool and surrounding outdoor space. Services include pool resurfacing, pool deck remodeling, pool tile replacement, pool equipment, new pool construction, and outdoor living improvements. Projects can focus on a single part of the pool or combine multiple improvements into a coordinated scope of work. To discuss your project, call 863-270-7792 or email [email protected] . Get a Free Estimate Pool Remodeling Focused on the Whole Backyard Pool remodeling involves more than changing how a swimming pool looks. The interior finish, waterline tile, deck, equipment, and surrounding outdoor areas all contribute to how the pool functions and how the backyard is used. Polk County Pool Remodeling focuses on identifying the work a property needs and developing a practical project scope. Homeowners can request individual services or discuss several pool and outdoor improvements together. More about us Our Services Our services cover key parts of residential pools and surrounding outdoor spaces. Pool resurfacing renews worn interiors, deck remodeling updates the area around the water, tile replacement refreshes the waterline, pool equipment services address operating components, new pool construction creates a pool from the ground up, and outdoor living improvements help connect the pool with the rest of the backyard. h1: Turn your Executive Expertise into warm ICP-qualified leads.
We capture your expertise once, turn it into authority-based content on LinkedIn and use our Media Engine to attract high-intent buyers.
Built for Executives who want to turn their LinkedIn presence into an Authority Engine that generates leads, pipeline and growth.
The market cannot buy expertise it cannot see and it will not trust expertise that never shows up where buyers research.
The problem is not a lack of expertise. The problem is invisible authority without a path to warm, high-intent buyers.
How the Done-For-You Authority Engine works
The executive remains the authority. Influx installs and operates the system that makes that authority commercially visible.
domains.visibleText: Apply Request a Discovery Call Short application. We review fit and respond with a clear next step. Applications are reviewed against capacity and fit. Limited systems are onboarded at a time to protect narrative quality, distribution attention, and reporting depth. By submitting, you agree to be contacted about your application. No spam. No automated hard-sell sequence that ignores fit. Request a Discovery Call See the Proof Who this is for Built for Executives who want to turn their LinkedIn presence into an Authority Engine that generates leads, pipeline and growth. Influx works with B2B Founders, CEOs, and Senior executives who lack the time to create content consistently and who have struggled to effectively find their voice on LinkedIn. Our engine facilitates close to 100% voice accuracy, whilst our team takes care of everything else, so you can focus on strategic priorities. 01 You lead a B2B company Founder, CEO, C-suite, VP, or Senior Operator - Your name and judgment affects deals, partnerships, hiring, and pipeline. 02 You want warm, high-intent ICP leads Reach matters only when the right buyers see you, trust you, and engage. Impressions alone are not the product. 03 You don’t want to be stuck creating content You can give ~1 hour for onboarding and timely approvals. You don’t want to spend your week writing posts or studying the LinkedIn algorithm. 04 You expect a managed system, not a writing tool You are not looking for a basic AI writer. You want an installed, done-for-you authority system operated with executive standards. If that sounds like you, request a Discovery Call. The problem is invisible authority without a path to warm, high-intent buyers. LOCAL DAILY RHYTHM 토닥이 서울 생활 리듬에 맞춘 방문 케어 서울은 생활권마다 하루의 흐름과 피로가 쌓이는 방식이 다릅니다. 오래 앉아 일하는 날과 장시간 서서 움직이는 날, 이동이 많은 날에 느끼는 불편함도 서로 다를 수 있습니다. 서울은 한강과 주요 업무지구, 산과 철도가 생활권을 여러 갈래로 나눈다. 종로·중구·용산은 도심 이동이 중심이고 강남·서초·송파는 강남대로와 테헤란로, 올림픽로 주변의 업무·상업·주거 기능이 촘촘하게 붙어 있다. 마포·서대문·은평은 서북부 철도와 언덕길을 함께 봐야 하며 노원·도봉·강북은 동북부 주거지와 산지 방향을 구분하는 편이 좋다. 서울토닥이는 정해진 방식만 반복하지 않습니다. 오래 앉아 있어 목과 어깨가 불편한 경우, 장시간 서서 일해 다리가 무거운 경우, 이동이 많아 전신에 피로가 쌓인 경우처럼 고객님의 현재 상태를 먼저 확인한 뒤 관리 강도와 진행 순서를 조절합니다. SERVICE AREA 토닥이 서울 이용이 가능한 주요 생활권 서울 여성전용 홈케어는 강남구·강동구·강북구·강서구·관악구·광진구·구로구·금천구·노원구·도봉구·동대문구·동작구·마포구·서대문구·서초구·성동구·성북구·송파구·양천구·영등포구·용산구·은평구·종로구·중구·중랑구를 기준으로 예약을 안내합니다. 현재 계신 지역의 구·동 또는 읍·면과 이용 장소의 유형을 함께 알려 주면 이동 동선을 확인하기 쉽습니다. 강남구 강동구 강북구 강서구 관악구 광진구 구로구 금천구 노원구 도봉구 동대문구 동작구 마포구 서대문구 서초구 성동구 성북구 송파구 양천구 영등포구 용산구 은평구 종로구 중구 중랑구 실제 배정 가능 여부와 도착 예정 시간은 예약 시점의 관리사 위치, 교통량, 날씨와 앞선 일정에 따라 달라질 수 있습니다. 서울특별시 안에서도 시간대별 도로 상황과 이동 거리가 달라질 수 있으므로 정확한 도착시간은 예약 상담에서 확인하는 것이 좋습니다. VISIT SPACE 토닥이 서울 자택부터 호텔까지 원하는 공간에서 편안하게 서울토닥이는 고객님이 가장 편하게 쉴 수 있는 장소를 기준으로 방문합니다. 자택에서는 관리 후 다시 이동하지 않고 바로 휴식할 수 있으며, 오피스텔이나 원룸에서는 익숙한 공간에서 조용하게 이용할 수 있습니다. 서울 출장이나 여행 중이라면 호텔과 레지던스에서도 방문 가능 여부를 확인할 수 있습니다. 다만 호텔, 게스트하우스와 레지던스는 외부 방문객 출입 규정이 서로 달라 로비 확인이나 방문객 등록이 필요하거나 객실 출입이 제한될 수 있습니다. 예약 전 프런트 또는 숙소 운영자에게 출입 가능 여부를 먼저 확인하면 현장에서 생길 수 있는 지연을 줄일 수 있습니다. 정확한 주소와 건물명, 동·호수, 공동현관 출입 방법은 관리사가 배정된 뒤 필요한 범위에서 전달하면 됩니다. RESERVATION PROCESS 토닥이 서울 여성전용출장마사지 예약은 어떻게 진행되나요? 서울토닥이 예약은 복잡하지 않습니다. 아래 순서대로 현재 위치와 이용 조건을 확인합니다. 01 현재 계신 서울 지역과 희망 시간을 전달합니다. 02 원하는 이용 시간과 집중적으로 관리받고 싶은 부위를 이야기합니다. 03 이용 코스, 비용, 추가비용 여부와 예상 도착시간을 확인합니다. 04 방문 가능한 관리사가 배정되면 안내된 정보를 확인합니다. 05 관리사가 도착한 후 강도와 불편한 부위를 다시 조율합니다. 06 안내받은 방식에 따라 서비스를 이용하고 결제를 진행합니다. 예약할 때에는 단순히 “서울입니다”라고 전달하기보다 구와 동, 이용 장소의 유형을 함께 알려 주는 것이 좋습니다. 예를 들어 “강남구 오피스텔”, “강동구 호텔”처럼 전달하면 이동 동선을 확인하기 쉽습니다. 이용 시간, 기본비용, 교통비, 심야 추가비용과 결제 방법은 예약을 확정하기 전에 반드시 안내받아야 합니다. 페이지에 표시된 내용과 실제 상담 내용이 다르다면 바로 확정하지 말고 총 결제금액을 다시 확인하는 것이 안전합니다. Fight for what you carry Hold the attack key and the blow lands when the weapon is out, so anything quick enough to step aside gets away with it. YOUR EDITING TIME, IN FOCUS Try the interactive demo The working dashboard, shown with example people, projects and time. A quieter way to track time Open Premiere. Get on with the edit. Once your Mac is connected, there is no project list to fill in and no timer to remember. 01 / OPEN Your project is the starting point. The companion reads the open project and active sequence from Premiere. Switching context updates where new time belongs. 02 / EDIT The timer follows your work. domains.description: A retirement forecaster that runs on your own device. Real tax tables, 1,000 Monte Carlo paths, no account to create.
domains.visibleText: F orecast Y our M oney About Docs Blog Disclaimer Open the app Will your money last? A retirement forecaster that models real taxes, real market history, and your actual accounts, without asking you to create an account or hand over bank credentials. Every plan gets a reading like this one: the share of 1,000 simulated futures in which the money never ran out. At 90% the gauge turns green, which means the plan lasts in all but the hardest stretches. Built differently Free to use, and meant to stay that way Not a trial, and not a teaser with the useful parts locked away. What you can use today is the whole forecaster, and the intention is to keep it that way. If it ever earns anything, it would be through optional extras, never by putting a wall around what already works. You can stay anonymous There is no account to create and no email to hand over. Some planners want an address before they will show you a single number; this one asks for nothing at all. It was built by people who are obsessive about their own privacy, so the instinct is a familiar one. If cloud sync is ever built, staying anonymous will remain a fully supported way to use this. Your plans stay on your device Everything you enter is saved in your own browser rather than on a server. Nothing you type is sent to us unless you later choose a feature that would, which means there is no copy of your finances sitting somewhere to be breached, sold, or quietly analyzed. Sync is something you would opt into, never the price of entry. Room for more than one plan A plan here is a complete, independent household rather than a saved variation on one profile. Run one against retiring early and another against working three more years, or keep a separate plan to help a parent or a friend think through theirs. They sit side by side, and editing one never disturbs another. Forecasts that move the way markets move A smooth upward curve is fiction. Real portfolios have good stretches and bad ones, and when the bad ones land matters as much as how bad they get. Every forecast runs 1,000 simulated futures drawn from a century of market history, and shows you the spread. Replay the market that actually happened Pick a starting year and watch your plan live through real history from that point forward: 1929, 1973, 2000, or anywhere else. It answers something a simulation cannot, which is how your own plan would have fared through the downturns people still talk about. Taxes modeled, not guessed Most calculators ask you for "your tax rate." Forecast Your Money applies 2026 federal and all-50-state statutory tables year by year: brackets, capital gains stacking, NIIT, payroll tax, RMDs, and taxable Social Security. It's a planning estimate, and we spell out the limits . Your own forecast, in about a minute Three amounts and a few dropdowns. No account, no email, no bank connection. domains.visibleText: SettlePal Menu Advantages Why Choose Us FAQ Contact Request Access Precision Intelligence for the Modern Investor. SettlePal leverages advanced predictive models to transform complex market data into actionable strategic advantages. Reduce risk through backtested AI automation. Explore the Platform The Methodology Data-Driven Certainty in Volatile Markets We move beyond simple heuristics. SettlePal processes millions of data points in real time to identify patterns invisible to the human eye, providing a foundation for institutional-grade decision making. Historical Backtesting Engine Real-time Risk Mitigation Automated Strategy Execution Capabilities Built for Traders Who Require Detail Each capability is designed to serve a distinct stage of the trading workflow, from early signal detection through to execution across multiple portfolios. Predictive Analytics Anticipate market shifts using deep learning models trained on decades of financial cycles. Decision Optimisation Remove emotional bias from your workflow with objective, data-backed recommendations. Scalable Infrastructure Deploy complex strategies across multiple assets simultaneously with zero latency. How It Works A Transparent Path from Data to Decision Understanding how a recommendation is formed matters as much as the recommendation itself. Our process is structured into three distinct, auditable stages. STEP 01 Ingestion Aggregating global market feeds and alternative data sets. STEP 02 Analysis Multi-layer neural networks evaluate risk-to-reward ratios. STEP 03 Output Delivery of precise, backtested strategic signals. Behind the Platform Engineered for Rigour, Not Novelty SettlePal was built on the premise that reliable signals come from disciplined data handling, not from chasing every emerging trend. Our models are retrained against extended historical windows before any output reaches a live account. The result is a system that favours consistency over spectacle, giving analysts a clearer view of risk before capital is committed.
