h1: Intelligente Crypto-Portfolio Optimalisatie voor de Serieuze Belegger
domains.visibleText: Qxfao Functionaliteiten Voordelen FAQ Contact Start Gratis Analyse Intelligente Crypto-Portfolio Optimalisatie voor de Serieuze Belegger Beheer al uw exchanges vanuit één centraal dashboard. Gebruik geavanceerde AI-analyse om risico's te minimaliseren en kansen te identificeren in realtime. Start Gratis Analyse Geconsolideerd beheer Eén Overzicht, Alle Exchanges Koppel moeiteloos uw accounts van verschillende exchanges via veilige API-verbindingen. Krijg een holistisch beeld van uw totale vermogen zonder te schakelen tussen tabbladen. Posities, allocaties en historische performance worden per exchange verzameld en samengevoegd tot één consistente weergave, zodat u beslissingen baseert op het volledige plaatje in plaats van fragmenten. Methodologie Hoe de AI-engine tot een aanbeveling komt Drie opeenvolgende stappen zetten marktdata om in concrete, onderbouwde suggesties voor uw portfolio. STAP 1 Data-aggregatie Continue monitoring van marktliquiditeit en prijsactie over alle gekoppelde exchanges, geconsolideerd tot één actuele dataset. STAP 2 Predictive Modeling AI-algoritmen simuleren duizenden scenario's om risico-rendement verhoudingen te berekenen en volatiliteit in kaart te brengen. STAP 3 Besluitvorming Ontvang concrete aanbevelingen voor herbalancering, gebaseerd op objectieve data in plaats van emotie of marktsentiment. Volatiliteitsreductie Risicobeheersing als Prioriteit Onze modellen zijn ontworpen om volatiliteit te navigeren, niet om deze te negeren. Stel automatische vangnetten in en ontvang waarschuwingen wanneer uw portfolio afwijkt van uw vooraf ingestelde risicoprofiel. Institutionele beveiliging van gekoppelde accountgegevens Geen directe toegang tot uw fondsen of kapitaal Real-time alerts bij afwijking van uw risicoprofiel Transparantie Hoe Qxfao Uw Data Beschermt Vertrouwen ontstaat door inzicht, niet door beloftes. Daarom leggen wij precies vast hoe onze aanbevelingen tot stand komen. 01 Read-only API toegang zorgt ervoor dat wij nooit direct bij uw kapitaal kunnen. Transacties blijven volledig onder uw eigen controle. 02 Onze AI-modellen worden wekelijks gebenchmarkt tegen marktprestaties, zodat afwijkingen tussen voorspelling en realiteit meetbaar blijven. 03 Volledige transparantie in hoe aanbevelingen tot stand komen: elke suggestie is herleidbaar naar de onderliggende data en aannames. Klaar voor Data-gedreven Investeren? Sluit u aan bij beleggers die vertrouwen op algoritmen in plaats van speculatie. h1: Talk through the job. Get an invoice back.
domains.visibleText: InvoiceAloud Invoicing, out loud with no typing, no template wrestling, no desk. Talk through the job. Get an invoice back. Say what you did and what it cost. It comes back as line items you can check and fix , then goes out as a PDF. Nobody should be thumb-typing an invoice at nine at night. The invoice you haven't sent is not a paperwork problem . It's money you already earned , sitting still. Why it stalls → Join the waitlist See how it works › No card, no account, nothing to install Speak → Check → Send → Paid Not launched yet · Built by one person · You can reply to me directly Twelve hours at one fifty an hour, three site visits at seventy-five each, and two hundred in materials. 12 Labour (hours) $1,800.00 3 Site visits $225.00 1 Materials $200.00 TOTAL $2,225.00 Sound familiar? You already know how to invoice. That was never the problem. The apps all shortened the same step: pick a template, add a logo, export a PDF. The part that actually stops people is the typing , eight line items with quantities and prices, on a phone. So the invoice waits for a desk, and the desk waits for Sunday, and you're a month behind on money you already earned . Built for people who invoice from a truck, a van, or somebody's kitchen: contractors, cleaners, photographers, tutors, groomers, detailers, landscapers, mobile trades. How it works Talk it out, check it, send it Speak Describe the job Tap record and describe the job the way you'd say it to the customer. Hours, materials, a flat rate, a discount you already agreed to. It works out which is which, and what each one costs. Check Nothing sends behind your back The line items come up first, editable, with a running total. Anything it isn't certain about gets flagged rather than guessed at. You decide when it goes. Send Pick a look and send it Templates made for different trades, with your logo and your colour on all of them. It leaves as a PDF from your name, not a no-reply address. Before you ask The price is the price. I won't do the thing this category is known for. Read the one-star reviews of any invoice app and it's the same review over and over: a weekly charge nobody remembers agreeing to, and a cancel button that isn't anywhere. I'm not building that. No weekly billing. Monthly or yearly. No introductory rate that quietly doubles. Cancel in two taps, inside the app. No phone call, no email, no retention specialist. Your invoices stay yours. Every document you've made is still there after you cancel. Free to start, no card. Make your first invoices before you decide anything. Sabrina Brooks, founder, Vantalyst Labs Inc. domains.visibleText: Aller au contenu Comparateur EdTech Catalogue Guides Classements Catégories Comparer Méthodologie Contact Explorer Base vérifiée en août 2026 · 586 solutions Le comparateur des logiciels de l'éducation LMS, ERP scolaire, émargement, examens, IA pédagogique… Filtrez 586 solutions sur les critères qui comptent vraiment et comparez-les côte à côte, en toute indépendance. Babbel Edflex Turnitin Klaxoon Moodle Genially Rise Up Cegid Talentsoft Learning PRONOTE EDT HYPERPLANNING Yparéo Edifice Explorer par usage 28 catégories, un besoin à la fois Chaque catégorie regroupe des solutions qui répondent au même besoin métier, avec une définition et des critères de choix documentés. Toutes les catégories LMS & plateformes de formation Un LMS (Learning Management System) est la plateforme qui héberge les parcours de formation, inscrit les apprenants, diffuse les contenus et trace la progression. C'est la brique centrale de tout dispositif de formation à distance ou hybride, aussi bien dans l'enseignement que dans l'entreprise. 71 solutions Soutien scolaire & parascolaire B2C Le soutien scolaire numérique regroupe les plateformes vendues aux familles ou aux élèves pour réviser, s'entraîner et combler des lacunes en dehors de la classe. L'offre va des cours en vidéo alignés sur les programmes officiels aux applications d'entraînement adaptatif et aux communautés d'entraide. 51 solutions Serious games & simulation Un serious game est un dispositif de formation qui emprunte les mécaniques du jeu vidéo pour faire acquérir des compétences, souvent comportementales ou procédurales. La simulation, elle, reproduit une situation professionnelle pour permettre l'entraînement répété sans risque réel. 38 solutions Orientation & admission Cette catégorie couvre deux moments distincts : l'aide à l'orientation, qui aide un jeune à construire son projet, et la gestion des admissions, qui outille l'établissement pour recruter et sélectionner ses candidats. En France, les deux s'articulent autour de Parcoursup et de Mon Master, plateformes publiques incontournables. 34 solutions IA générative pour l'éducation L'IA générative appliquée à l'éducation couvre les assistants conversationnels encadrés pour établissements, les générateurs de contenus pédagogiques à partir de documents existants, les moteurs d'apprentissage adaptatif et les détecteurs de textes produits par IA. UK menu prices Find a Dixy near you 144 UK shops listed Official hygiene ratings Free calculators What is Dixy Chicken? Dixy Chicken is a British halal fried chicken chain. It was founded in Solihull in 1986, grew through franchising, and is now run by Dixy Group Holdings Limited from its head office in Bury, Greater Manchester. Most Dixy Chicken shops are in England, with the biggest clusters in Birmingham, London and Manchester, and there are a handful abroad. The Dixy Chicken menu is built on fried chicken pieces, fillet burgers, wraps, hot wings, chips and family buckets, and it usually sells itself as the cheaper halal alternative to KFC, Chicken Cottage and the other high-street chicken shops. Because almost every shop is franchised separately, there’s no single national price list. Two branches on the same road can charge different amounts for the same meal. So we put together typical price ranges from branch menus and delivery-app listings where we can find them, fill the gaps with clearly labelled estimates, and update them when readers send corrections. We also list every Dixy Chicken shop on the Food Standards Agency hygiene register, so you can check a branch’s rating before you order on Just Eat, Uber Eats or Deliveroo. domains.title: Cold Labs - The scientific way to win your biggest accounts through cold email.
domains.description: Most agencies blast emails. We build systems. Cold Labs is a cold email agency for other B2B agencies.
h1: The scientific way to win your biggest accounts through cold email.
domains.visibleText: Process Proof More proof Even more proof Careers Let's chat BUILT ON clay claude code The scientific way to win your biggest accounts through cold email. Most agencies blast emails. We build systems. Get a free 30-minute call We are certified partners of Some of the brands we work with The mechanism The 98% play. Most agencies fight over the 2% of the market ready to buy right now. We built systems to capture the other 98%. Step 01 Engineering your offer for cold traffic. Your dream accounts already have an agency in place. Fancy personalization won't make them switch. Neither will asking a VP of growth for 15 minutes of their time. We spend 70% of our attention on engineering your offer for cold traffic. We'll show you how to get strangers excited to talk to you. Step 02 We build a custom database of your entire market. Most companies pull from the same Apollo lists everyone else can reach. Same prospects → Same approach → Same results We scrape custom directories and niche databases. Enrich every company with intent signals, and build a profile of your entire market. Then we qualify each company with an AI model trained on your business. The ones that fit go into your database. Think of it as your own ZoomInfo - but only the companies that are a perfect fit, sorted by intent. The goal: reach every company in your market, but not with the same message. We wait until a company shows it needs you, then we build the outreach for that exact moment. Step 03 Reply-to-call flows. Most agencies measure leads. 'Lead' is a vanity metric. If you want cold traffic to convert like warm referrals, you have to build the system between the reply and the call. Otherwise every meeting starts cold, and your sales team is closing strangers. Here's the flow we engineer: → AI agents draft your responses to positive replies, with a human reviewing every message. → Every agent learns from your replies. The more you reply, the better it gets. → We build 'thank-you page' videos that educate the prospect once they schedule a meeting. → We set up 'pre-call sequences' with technical breakdowns, case studies, FAQs, and educational content. Everything is timed so that by the time the prospect shows up, they're excited to talk to you. Cold → warm → excited. Engineered as a system. Step 04 We document every campaign. We track every dollar back. Before any campaign launches, we document the hypothesis: who we're targeting, what offer we're testing, what we expect to happen. Then we track it all the way to closed revenue. Email sent. Reply received. Meeting booked. Deal closed. Full attribution, live in your dashboard. This is how we build your knowledge base. The more campaigns we run, the better we can predict which segments, offers, and angles will work next. Every test compounds. Every iteration sharpens the next. Step 05 Scale. When something looks wrong, it finds the job behind it and sends the cause and fix to Slack. Email Request access Early access. We let in a few projects each week. # data-alerts Sodabase APP 03:11 public.orders hasn’t had a new row since 02:14. It usually gets 60 to 110 an hour. Cause The sync_orders cron hasn’t run since 02:00. Its last run is still waiting on a lock held by refresh_analytics , so every run since has been skipped. Fix Cancel the stuck run and start sync_orders again. Want me to go ahead? Approve Steer run cancelled · job re-run · 412 rows What it catches Things can break without anything actually crashing. Stale A cron job or sync stops writing. The table is still there, but the data is from yesterday. Schema changed An edge function or app expects a column that was renamed, removed, or changed. Wrong The table keeps updating, but the numbers don’t look right. Rows duplicate, values spike, or something writes bad data. How it works Connect Supabase. Sodabase figures out the rest. 01 Connect your project Sign in with Supabase and choose a project. Sodabase reads your tables, cron jobs, edge functions, and the logs behind them. 02 It learns how your tables normally change Sodabase learns when each table usually updates and what its data normally looks like. You don’t have to set rules for every table. 03 When something breaks, you get the fix in Slack Sodabase finds what went wrong, points you to the cron job, edge function, sync, or agent that caused it, and tells you what to do next. An estimated 3 to 4 million bitcoin will never move again. Almost none of it was hacked. A single copy failed in three ordinary ways. The copy that was destroyed. A fire, a flood, a move, a drawer emptied by someone who did not know what the paper was. One accident, and everything is gone at once. The copy that was stolen. A burglary, a roommate, a photo that synced to an account you forgot you had. Whoever holds those twelve words holds everything. There is no way to reverse it. The copy nobody found. How Seedcase works. Three moves: Split the phrase. Place the fragments. Get the seed phrase back when you need it. 01 Split Split your seed phrase into as many fragments as you want, and choose how many are needed to put it back together. Two of three, four of seven, seven of ten: you define the rule. No single fragment works alone. 02 Store Each fragment goes to a different place: a vault, a family home, a notary's office... You choose where each one lives. No single location holds the full secret. 03 Reconstruct When you need it, bring together the number of fragments you chose and reconstruct the original seed phrase. A fragment is an object. Printed sheet The fragment's words printed in full, beside a Seedcase QR. The format a notary can file, a bank can hold, and an heir can read without an app. Mobile vault A fragment held in the Seedcase encrypted vault app. Sealed at rest, always on you. Metal plate Fire and water resistant. For the fragment that has to survive the house, not just the decade. Desktop vault A fragment held in an encrypted vault on a computer. Sealed at rest. EAL5+ NFC card planned An additional layer of security, on a certified chip. Credit-card format, for a wallet. What people use it for. Transmission. Fragments go to a family member, a notary, a vault... where none of them can act alone. Together, when the moment comes, they recover everything. No account, no technical knowledge. A backup with no single point of failure. Your seed phrase stops living in one place. Lose a fragment and you still recover everything. Someone finds a fragment and they still have nothing. domains.title: Josh Clinton — I build AI that does real work
domains.description: Josh Clinton — CS student at Penn State building computer vision and applied machine learning that ships into the real world.
h1: I build AI that does real work.
domains.visibleText: Josh Clinton about work education reach out Josh Clinton CS · Penn State · graduating Dec 2026 prev. Northrop Grumman, B. Braun Medical I build AI that does real work. Last year I built a computer-vision system that inspects vials and syringes for an IV compounder before they reach a patient , catching label and fill errors before a pharmacist has to. I'm looking for software and firmware engineering roles starting early 2027, especially anywhere AI is breaking new ground. See what I've built Get in touch J Ask me a few things Hey — ask me about myself. about me What I'm about I'm a CS student at Penn State , graduating December 2026, and I'm hooked on the exact moment an AI model stops being an experiment and starts changing something real. At B. Braun , that moment was watching my vision system flag a mislabeled vial that a person had missed — software quietly standing between a mistake and a patient. That's what pulls me toward computer vision and applied machine learning, from that system to building the training data behind AI coding tools at Handshake AI . I've also got a serious interest in computer engineering. My summer at Northrop Grumman writing C++ for FPGA-based hardware pushed me past CS into embedded systems, and gave me a better feel for how software has to behave inside a physical product. I'm a self-driven learner, always eager to pick up something new: a new corner of AI, a language I haven't touched, or a problem I don't yet know how to solve. Lately that has meant working through the math and algorithms behind ray tracing by writing a Monte Carlo path tracer in C++ from scratch, and getting a feel for how neural networks behave by building one in Python to train a car to drive itself. I'm just as passionate about training my own brain as I am about training a neural network. what I've built AI, put to work computer vision · in production Medical Vision Inspection B. Braun Medical — the project I'm most proud of Patent pending — named inventor I built a real-time vision system that inspects medical vials and syringes, catching errors in NDC codes, expiration dates, lot numbers, and fill volumes. I designed and trained custom ResNet and YOLO models and paired them with EasyOCR to read each label. It's part of a larger inspection system that has a patent pending with my name on it. PyTorch YOLO ResNet EasyOCR PHP real-time defect detection multi-site used on the floor NDC 0264·9876 EXP 2027·04 LOT A1B2C3 VOL 4.2 mL · low other AI work Neural Car neural net + genetic algorithm, from scratch in numpy A car that teaches itself to drive randomly generated tracks. Both the network and the genetic algorithm are written from scratch — no PyTorch, no autograd, no optimizer. Seven distance rays plus the car's own speed feed 8 inputs through 10 tanh units to steering and throttle Learns by evolution rather than gradients: tournament selection, uniform crossover, 15% gaussian mutation, and elitism so a good generation can't be lost to bad

domains.description: Ticari arıcılık işletmeleri için arılık ölçeğinde erken uyarı sistemi. Kraliçesizlik, oğul öncesi risk ve koloni zayıflamasını kovan açılmadan haber verir. Geliştirme aşamasında, 2027 saha pilotu.

Ticari arıcılık işletmeleri için arılık ölçeğinde erken uyarı sistemi. Kraliçesizlik, oğul öncesi risk ve koloni zayıflamasını kovan açılmadan haber verir. Ticari arıcının yüzlerce kovanı uzak arılıklara dağılmış; hangisine önce gitmesi gerektiğini bilmeden yola çıkıyor. Her açılış koloniyi yoruyor Durumu görmenin en yaygın yolu kovanı açmak; her açılış koloniyi strese sokuyor, ısı-nem dengesini bozuyor ve iş gücü istiyor. Sorun iki muayene arasında büyüyor Kraliçe kaybı, oğul ve zayıflama iki muayene arasında gelişiyor. Open the app Download on the App Store Learn more Coverage We support your bank. Meridian connects through Plaid, the same service your other financial apps use. Every institution Plaid supports, Meridian supports — every national bank, every regional one, the credit unions, the card issuers and the brokerages. We keep no shorter list of our own. Chase Bank of America Wells Fargo American Express Discover Citi Capital One Fidelity Charles Schwab Robinhood Vanguard U.S. Bank PNC Truist Ally SoFi Navy Federal E*TRADE The full picture Getting the full picture has never been so easy. Every subscription, every bill, every standing order — found for you, totalled, and laid out on the month they land on. Nosotros preferimos empezar por algo más pequeño y más real: que te ahorre el lunes por la mañana. Después vemos lo grande. Descubre por qué nos llamamos así El nombre leew viene de leeway , un término de náutica. Es el margen que tiene un barco para moverse cuando el viento lo empuja de costado. domains.visibleText: DivCheck Home Features Pricing Privacy Support Terms Coming soon ☰ Home Features Pricing Privacy Support Terms iPhone app · Free, unlock once This week you get paid. See your dividend paycheck at a glance. See what your dividends pay you this week — and what they might pay next month — without opening a brokerage. Add your stocks and ETFs, and DivCheck turns their payouts into a calendar you can actually read. Get DivCheck — coming to the App Store See how it works Free with up to 15 holdings. Unlock everything for $9.99, once — no subscription. Price shown in your local currency on the App Store. What DivCheck is not: it's not a broker, not a trading app, not a live-quote terminal, and it doesn't connect to any brokerage account or to Apple's Stocks app. There's no login and no DivCheck account — your holdings live on your iPhone. How it works Four steps, no spreadsheet required DivCheck turns a list of tickers into a paycheck you can plan around. Add your holdings Type in tickers and share counts, or import a positions CSV from Fidelity, Schwab, Vanguard, IBKR, or a simple ticker,shares list. Cash, money-market, and options positions are skipped automatically. DivCheck builds the estimate We look up prices and dividend history, then estimate future payouts from each holding's typical recent payment — ignoring one-off specials — multiplied by your share count. See your paycheck Daily is roughly annual ÷ 365; monthly is roughly annual ÷ 12. Your dashboard shows this week, this month, and this year, split into cash you'll actually receive vs. shares reinvested through DRIP. Track the calendar Every upcoming payout shows buy-by, ex-date, and paid-on timing, clearly labeled declared vs. estimated. Add them straight into Apple Calendar with one tap — DivCheck can only write events, never read what's already there. Five tabs Everything lives where you'd expect ◧ Dashboard Your paycheck home — this week, an income horizon out to a year, goal progress, and how much has actually paid out this year. Reorder, hide, or collapse any panel to make it yours. ☰ Portfolio Every holding, sortable and searchable, with yield on cost and notes. ▦ Calendar A month grid of estimated pay dates, tap any day for the detail. ▤ News Headlines tied to what you own, plus a bit of general market news. ⚙ Settings Your monthly goal, appearance, accounts, import notes, legal info, and a Start Over section to clear holdings or reset settings without losing anything else. Timing, made clear Buy by. Ex-date. Paid on. DivCheck's calendar marks the days that matter for each holding, so you're never guessing whether a payout already landed or is still projected. Declared payouts are shown separately from estimates When a company hasn't published a date yet, DivCheck infers one from the ex-date and marks it with a ~ Add payouts straight into Apple Calendar — write-only access, and tapping again never creates duplicates Local notifications remind you the morning of, or up to 14 days ahe

domains.visibleText: bright phone Example call Features Getting started FAQ Sign in 7 day free trial AI receptionist for small businesses Every call answered. Every message written down. BrightPhone picks up your business line on the first ring, day and night. It answers the questions callers keep asking, takes a message you can act on, and puts the urgent calls through to a person. Set up my receptionist Eleven at night. A burst pipe. A tenant with water coming through the ceiling, and a receptionist that knows an emergency from a work order. receptionist Thanks for calling Northgate Property Management. This call is recorded. How can I help? caller Hi, there's water coming through my kitchen ceiling and it's getting worse. receptionist That sounds urgent. Can I have your name and the unit number? caller Dana Reyes, unit 4B on Elm Street. receptionist Thank you, Dana. I'm putting you through to the on-call plumber now. Please stay on the line. what you see in the morning Transferred to the on-call plumber at 11:04 PM. Nothing for you to do. The summary, transcript and recording are on the call's page. Features Someone on the line, every time, who knows your business and what to ask. Built first for property managers; the same rules serve HVAC, trades, and any business whose phone is its front door. Answered on the first ring. Nights, weekends, holidays, and the minutes when everyone is already on a call. No voicemail, no hold music. Answers from your website. Point it at the pages that matter. Nothing reaches a caller until you have approved it. A message you can act on. Name, callback number, what it is about, when to call back. Every field is yours to change. Urgent calls reach a person. You list who takes calls and when. Inside those hours the caller is put through; outside them, a message is taken. English and French. Canadian French, spoken the way your callers speak it. The call follows the caller's language. Your hours, your holidays. Set them once. A change takes effect the moment you save it. Every call on the record, and a short list of the ones that need you. This is the morning after, as your dashboard shows it. When From Length Summary 2026-09-21 23:04 +14165550142 Dana Reyes 1:12 Water through the kitchen ceiling at 4B Elm Street. Transferred to the on-call plumber. 2026-09-21 20:31 +16475550198 Marc Lavoie 2:05 Le lave-vaisselle du 12 ne démarre plus. Message pris, rappel demandé demain matin. 2026-09-21 17:52 +19055550117 3:40 Asked for a person about a lease renewal. Nobody free; name and number taken for a callback. 2026-09-21 09:15 +14165550170 0:48 Wanted the office hours and the address. Answered from your website. Only what needs you. A caller asked for a person, a question went unanswered, a transfer did not connect: those wait in a review queue, counted in the header until you have looked. Your data, where you work. Signed webhooks push each finished call to your own systems, and an API lets you pull. Getting started Three steps, one sitting.

domains.visibleText: Skip to content Zephyr Features How it works Pricing Blog Help Get early access Features How it works Pricing Blog Help Security Contact Get early access AI operations assistant Work comes in. Zephyr makes sure it gets done. Your AI operations assistant for requests, deadlines, follow-ups and everything that falls between the cracks. On iPhone and Android. Get early access See how it works Approval on everything No autonomous sends, ever iOS & Android One assistant, both platforms Not training data Your content is never used to train external models One loop, one app Six tools, five handoffs. Or one. The loop is always the same: something arrives, it becomes an action, someone approves it, someone chases it. Almost nobody runs that loop in one place — and every handoff between tools is somewhere work can quietly stop moving. The usual stack Notes app catches the thing To-do list holds the action Calendar holds the date Email & chat carries the chase Meeting recorder holds what was said A spreadsheet holds who owes you what With Zephyr Capture Voice, photo, text — whatever is to hand Propose Actions, owners and dates, drafted for you Approve You decide. Nothing sends on its own Follow up The chase happens without you remembering Same loop. No handoffs, because there is nothing to hand off to. Plenty of tools do one of these well. What is unusual is closing the loop — and the closing is the part that decides whether the work actually happens. Why this keeps happening The cost is not the tools. It is the space between them Zephyr has no customers yet, so it has no results to quote. These are other people's numbers about the problem, each one traceable to the study it came from. 60 % of a knowledge worker's time goes on coordination rather than the work they were hired to do. Asana, Anatomy of Work Index 2021 — 13,123 workers 9.5 min to get back into a productive flow after switching between apps. Twenty-five switches a day is the average. Qatalog & Ellis Idea Lab, Cornell University, 2022 2 min between interruptions — about 275 a day, once meetings, email and notifications are counted together. Microsoft, Work Trend Index, June 2025 101 apps in the average company, past a hundred for the first time. Adding a seventh tool is not the answer to six. Okta, Businesses at Work 2025 What it does Three jobs, one system Zephyr isn't a chatbot with a to-do list bolted on. It's the operational memory that sits underneath your day. Capture anything A voice note on your way into a meeting, a scanned form, a forwarded email, a screenshot of a group chat. Every input enters one pipeline and comes out the other side as something you can act on. Know what needs doing Zephyr reads what came in and proposes the action, the owner and the deadline — and names whatever it was unsure about, so you're never left guessing what's actually real. domains.visibleText: bookmove . Train My games ? YOUR NEXT LINE The London System Ready to learn B The book A consistent opponent. Every time. Then make it yours. 153 book entries + 30 extended lessons Find a line Opening family Choose a variation Classical setup SOLID & STEADY Build a reliable centre and bring your bishop out early. A familiar setup you can make your own. Classical setup Your colour White Black ⤨ Random Let the board decide. Learn either side. How far do you want to go? Moves per side 5 10 15 30 Pick any whole number from 1 to 30. Each move includes White + Black. Learn this line → 01 Learn with hints 02 Play from memory Small repetitions. Stronger instincts. About the lines ↗ × THE BOOKMOVE METHOD A line worth remembering. Pick your practice. Search for an opening, choose its variation and pick White, Black or Random. Book lessons support 1–10 moves per side; extended lessons support 1–30. Learn one branch. Follow the highlighted move. The book plays the other side of your chosen variation, with the same replies each attempt. Try from memory. You get one optional idea hint per attempt, with no move or square revealed. Leaving the selected line ends the attempt and shows the expected move. A recognised alternative is labelled as another catalogue line. Make it stick. Retry, revisit the guided lesson, or keep playing against a simple practice opponent after reaching your target. The original 152 book entries contain 116 distinct sequences over the first 10 moves. An additional Englund Gambit lesson covers the main queen-attack line. Some named variations share those moves and separate later. Their lessons are labelled as introductions when the full reference continues beyond the selected length. Different legal moves can be good chess and still be outside this memory exercise. Opening references & credits The 152 book entries use the first 10 full moves of every qualifying sequence in the Lichess opening dataset (CC0). Repeated names identify separate source references. The additional Englund Gambit lesson follows the 8.Nd5 variation in Ian Simpson’s published analysis , with original Bookmove explanations. The named sequences are opening references, not a promise that every move is best. The original 30 extended lessons remain available. They cover a practical selection from Chess.com’s popular openings catalogue ; popularity varies by rating and time control. Their later moves are illustrative middlegame continuations prepared with Stockfish . Rules: chess.js (BSD-2-Clause). Pieces: Colin M. L. Burnett / Lichess, CC BY-SA 3.0 . domains.visibleText: Motion Studies An atlas of movement Cities move twice Once through space. Once through data. Distance becomes connection. A schematic motion study Motion Studies is a catalogue of authored works about transport, geography, and the different ways a moving city becomes legible. Four spatial arguments. 005 Live study Gleislicht Switzerland A deliberately built national clockwork, revealed through rail, terrain, Takt, air and road. 006 Live study All Change London Physical London transforms into Beck-space while every journey continues uninterrupted. 007 Corridor proof Local / Express New York Two speeds of city compress, overtake and rejoin across geographic and diagrammatic New York. 008 Live study Correspondances Paris Métro circulation and outward RER eruptions expose the relationship between centre and banlieue. The instrument Movement is not one kind of knowledge. 01 Scheduled Timetables become interpolated journeys: the intended choreography of a city. 02 Observed Broadcast positions become smoothed trajectories: visitors crossing above the plan. 03 Reconstructed Aggregate flow and speed become particles: measured traffic without imagined tracking. domains.visibleText: Convertum Convertum — Every tool you need to convert, edit & compress files Convertum — Fast, 100% private in-browser tools for PDFs, images, media, and code. Zero cloud uploads, zero tracking. 100% private, fast in-browser... 🔒 100% Client-Side Privacy ⚡ Instant WebAssembly 🚫 Zero Uploads & No Limits ✨ 100% Free Forever Initializing high-performance local workspace... How to Use Convertum STEP 1 Upload or Select File Drag and drop your file into the active workspace or click to select from your device. No sign-up or email required. STEP 2 Configure & Process Locally Adjust any desired settings or parameters. WebAssembly executes high-speed processing directly inside your browser. STEP 3 Save & Download Output Save your processed file immediately to your device with zero upload latency or cloud file retention. Why Choose Convertum for Convertum? 🔒 100% Zero-Trust Privacy Unlike cloud converters, your files never leave your device. All computation stays 100% isolated in your browser sandbox. ⚡ Zero Server Queue Latency Native client-side WebAssembly execution eliminates slow network uploads, remote server queues, and bandwidth bottlenecks. ✨ Unlimited & Zero Watermarks Enjoy unlimited conversions and file edits without artificial restrictions, hidden trial limits, or branding watermarks. 📱 Cross-Platform Compatibility Fully compatible across Windows, macOS, Linux, ChromeOS, iOS, and Android using standard modern browser engines. Frequently Asked Questions Is Convertum safe to use with confidential data? Yes, completely safe. Because Convertum processes everything locally in your browser memory, your confidential files, passwords, financial records, and medical data are never transmitted over the internet or stored on external servers. Is there any cost or limit on file size? Convertum is 100% free with no hidden fees or subscriptions. File size is only limited by your device's available memory, meaning you can process large files without artificial cloud caps. Does Convertum work offline? Yes. Once the web application and its WebAssembly modules are cached by your browser, you can continue to convert, format, and process files even without an active internet connection.

domains.description: APIs for Australian official data, built from the government gazettes. Product one: public holidays, regional show days and school terms for every state and territory.
h1: Australian official data, as an API.
domains.visibleText: gazetted Australian official data, as an API. The gazettes hold the facts that Australian software keeps getting wrong. Gazetted reads them, keeps them current, and serves them as JSON with the source line attached. Dates Public holidays, regional show days and school terms for all eight states and territories, by state and district. Every record carries the government URL it came from. Free for statewide holidays this year; A$99 a year for regional days, statewide holidays from 2020 to 2027, all school terms and a change feed. Docs and free API key Plans Why gazettes State governments publish holidays, show days and term dates as dated announcements, one state at a time, in eight different formats. Most libraries copy them once and go stale. Gazetted stores the published dates, not rules, and each record says where it came from, so when Western Australia moves a regional holiday, the API changes and the source line tells you why. How it works Sign up with an email, get an API key in a one-time link. Call GET /v1/is-holiday?state=WA&date=2026-09-28&q=karratha and get the gazetted answer for that district. Responses carry a data version. Revalidate with If-None-Match and refetch only when something changed. The annual plan is A$99 a year. Card payments open shortly; until then we invoice. Who runs it Gazetted is operated by GSZ Capital Pty Ltd as trustee for The GSZ Capital Trust, ABN 24 396 958 037, Victoria, Australia. Questions, invoices, data corrections: hello@gazetted.dev . domains.description: Mahfouz is a calm, open Markdown workspace with zero lock-in. Your notes are plain files anyone — and any agent — can read and edit directly, versioned and shared with Git.
domains.visibleText: Skip to content Features Git history Downloads Compare User guide Open. No lock-in. Ever. Notes that stay yours. Mahfouz keeps your notes as plain Markdown files in a folder on your computer — nothing proprietary, nothing to export. Open and edit them with any editor, script, or AI agent, and let Git look after their history. Download Mahfouz Read the user guide Available for macOS, Windows, and Linux — and your files work the same without it. A note in your vault Markdown # Things worth keeping Small notes can stay small. Links make room for the bigger picture. See also: [[Ideas]] #garden Plain text on your computer History in Git A little more room to think Your notes, without the lock-in. Write in Markdown, follow ideas across your vault, and keep every note in a format that will still make sense years from now — one that any editor, tool, or agent can open without asking Mahfouz first. A home for every thought. Keep notes as ordinary Markdown files in folders you choose. Open several vaults, shape notes into a tree, and pin the ones you return to. Nested notes and folders Multiple vaults and tabs Bookmarks and tags Every file readable and editable outside Mahfouz — no export step Illustrative workspace preview showing a note tree, Markdown editor, backlinks, and tags. Move through ideas, not folders. Link notes by title, see what points back, and search every open vault. A live outline and page preview help you find your place in longer notes. Wikilinks and backlinks Fast vault-wide search Outline and page preview Illustrative search preview with matching notes and highlighted text from across the vault. Every change has a way back. Git records edits as you work. Browse a note’s history, restore an earlier version, recover deleted notes from Trash, or sync your vault with a remote. Automatic commits Per-note history Remote sync and restore Illustrative note history preview showing automatic Git saves and earlier versions. When a note wants to become more Write it once. Present it when you’re ready. Use the formatting toolbar, tables, checklists, and media as you write. Turn a note into a slide deck with the presentations plugin, then export a PDF when you need a copy to share. A familiar tool, built in Real history. Real collaboration. Mahfouz uses Git to record edits, show past versions, and restore a note without erasing what came before. Because Git is distributed, your vault isn’t tied to one server — push it to GitHub, self-host it, or hand a copy to a collaborator, and everyone keeps working from their own full copy of the history. Everyday edits Saved as Git commits automatically. Past versions Browse a note’s history and restore a version. Remote sync Use your existing Git setup and credentials. domains.title: CannaChef — Cooking with cannabis, calculated
domains.description: Decarb, infusion and dosing calculators that show their work, plus a recipe library that rescales every ingredient to the potency of the oil you actually made.
domains.visibleText: beta Canna Chef Cooking with cannabis Search recipes Recipes Methods Calculators Terpenes Dosing guide Batches Cooking with cannabis Every number shows its work. Decarb, infusion and dosing calculators that give you an honest range instead of a confident guess — and a recipe library that rescales itself to the potency of the oil in your fridge. Calculate my infusion Browse recipes The tools Start with the arithmetic The four-step calculation every edible needs, broken into the questions people actually ask. All calculators → Infusion potency How strong is my butter? Flower, potency, method and fat in. Milligrams per tablespoon out, as an honest range. Recipe dosing How strong is each cookie? Split an infusion across a batch — or work backwards from the dose you want per serving. Concentrates How strong is it with distillate? Distillate, RSO, rosin, hash or kief instead of flower. Answers the decarb question first. Decarb How long, and at what temperature? Time and temperature for a target conversion, plus what it costs you in terpenes. Batch scaler How do I double this without doubling the dose? Rescale any recipe with the per-serving dose held exactly where it was. Cost per milligram Is making it actually cheaper? Flower cost in, cost per edible out. Usually the answer is yes by a wide margin. Recipe of the day Overnight oats Breakfast Low Easy No cook Assembled in a jar the night before, eaten cold. No heat anywhere in the process, which makes it the gentlest thing on the site for an infusion. Written for 2.5 mg per jar Makes 2 jars · 5 min Open the recipe Browse all recipes How this is different Built as software, not a food blog Honest math Ranges, not false precision Nobody can tell you the milligrams in a cookie without a lab. Every result here is a band with the assumptions printed beside it, because a single confident number would be a guess in a lab coat. Live rescaling Recipes that match your oil Set your infusion strength once. Every recipe on the site rewrites its own ingredient amounts and per-serving dose to match what you actually made — no mental arithmetic, no conversion tables. Shows its work Every constant is written down Decarb efficiency, transfer rates, the molar conversion — all of it sits on one page with its reasoning attached, so you can check the math instead of trusting it. The library Recipes that do the math for you Cooking with cannabis is a fat substitution — you swap butter for cannabutter and the rest of the recipe is ordinary cooking. So every recipe here stores its infused fat as a volume and a target dose rather than a fixed milligram figure, and recalculates the moment you tell it how strong your oil is. Browse the library Canna Chef Every number shows its work. domains.description: Half Five picks tonight's dinner from the meals your household already cooks. One card at half five, one tap, and the evening's sorted.
domains.visibleText: Half Five Menu Features Pricing FAQ Support Download on the App Store At half five, dinner's decided. Half Five picks tonight from the meals your household already cooks. One card, one tap, and that's the evening sorted. Download on the App Store See it One card. Not six options. "Tonight, already decided" Screenshot placeholder "Answer it from the lock screen" Screenshot placeholder "Not that one? Say what you fancy." "Your meals, not a stranger's" How it works Four steps, and three of them are a tap. 1 Tell it what you cook Your household's own meals, once. Type them, or photograph a recipe page, a whole recipe, or the list on the fridge. 2 Half five: one card Tonight's meal, picked from your meals, with a short reason why. It arrives as a notification and sits on your lock screen. 3 Yes, or say what you fancy One yes settles it. Not that one? Tap a different mood or type your own words, and it offers something else. 4 It remembers Half Five knows what you've had lately, so the meal you'd forgotten about comes back round. The whole story The meals are already yours. Most evenings the problem isn't that you can't cook. It's that nobody wants to be the one who decides, and by half five it's too late to think about it properly. So Half Five decides. At your household's card time, one card: tonight's dinner, chosen from the meals you already cook, with a line saying why. Answer it on the notification, on your lock screen, or in the app. One yes settles it, or you can set your household so two adults have to agree. If it's wrong, say so. Tap a different mood, or type what you actually fancy, and Half Five offers something else from your own meals. Nothing gets recommended that your house has never eaten, unless you go looking for it. It watches what you've had lately, which is the whole trick: the meal everyone likes but nobody has thought of since February comes back round on its own. Tell it which allergens your household avoids, and new recipes that list them stop being suggested. That's health information, so Half Five asks for your explicit consent first, keeps the list in our own database and sends it nowhere. It doesn't check your own meals, and it's a convenience, not a safety system: read the actual ingredients and the actual packaging, every time. Children eat earlier, so Half Five can keep leftovers for them. It holds a child's first name and nothing else, and it never shows a number about a child. domains.description: A private, permissioned home for your family's documents - on your own domain, with a plan for what happens when someone dies.
h1: Where a family keeps what matters.
domains.visibleText: Family Records Pricing Sign in Start Where a family keeps what matters. The deed, the will, the policy numbers, the photograph of the house before the porch was rebuilt. One private place for all of it, on your own domain, with the permissions worked out before anybody needs them. Start a family See what it costs Already have a family? Sign in at your family’s own address. Enter it and we’ll take you there. Your family's address Sign in Permission is the product Records belong to categories; categories belong to groups; people belong to groups. Nobody is ever granted access individually, because groups outlive people and a list of individuals does not. The rules are enforced by the database, not by the page you happen to be looking at. On your own domain Your family reaches the archive at your name, not ours. Bring a domain you already own, or start on one we give you and move later. A public page introduces the family; everything behind it needs a sign-in and two-factor. A plan for the worst day Succession is a feature, not a support ticket. An owner proposes, a second owner confirms, and the change takes effect after a week in which everyone can see it coming. Nothing about a death happens quietly, and nothing about it requires a court order. You can leave Your documents sit in ordinary object storage under an ordinary key layout, and you can pull all of them down with standard tools without asking us. An archive you cannot walk out of is not an archive. Built for one family first, which is the only honest way to build this. The Burns family archive runs on it at their own domain, and everything they can do, you can do. familyrecords.app Pricing Sign in Start a family

Coming to the App Store Read the source iPhone and iPad · Everything stays on your phone 15 posts, 9 minutes. No verdict. Just a moment to choose. Why not just block it? Blocking breeds wanting. Kindness breeds choice. Kindgate is built on five findings from behavioural research. Each one shaped a screen. Forbidden fruit Tell children not to eat the red snacks and they eat more of them. Restriction makes the restricted thing more attractive. Psychologists call it reactance. A hard block is a red-food rule. Jansen, Mulkens & Jansen, 2007 · Kindgate never blocks; it asks. The doughnut study Guilt after a lapse causes the binge, not the lapse. Restrictive eaters given one doughnut and a short self-compassion prompt ate less afterwards than those left to feel bad. Adams & Leary, 2007 · The check-in logs a feeling with no verdict. Urges pass A craving peaks and fades within minutes, if you let it. Riding an urge out beats fighting it. So instead of a flat no, Kindgate offers ten minutes. Bowen & Marlatt, 2009 · The 10-minute delay button. Decide earlier Plans made in advance are kept far more often than plans made under temptation. Implementation intentions have a medium-to-large effect on follow-through across hundreds of studies. Gollwitzer & Sheeran, 2006 · Evening cards show your pre-set plans, one tap each. Friction, not force People want support that is not coercive, yet cannot be ignored. A review of 367 digital self-control tools found that sweet spot is where tools actually help. Lyngs et al., CHI 2019 · A short countdown on “continue anyway”. Willpower runs out. Kindness compounds. What it does YouTube, subscriptions only Opens on Subscriptions. No Home feed, no Shorts, no recommendations, no autoplay. Search, channels and playlists keep working. Instagram, people you follow Locked to the Following feed. Reels, Explore, suggested posts and sponsored posts are gone. A check-in, not a block Every 15 posts a card shows how many posts and minutes went by. Keep going, or that’s enough. Your call. Warm screen at night After your set hour every page eases toward candlelight. Contrast survives, layouts never break. Hands off to Shortcuts Any button can run a shortcut of yours. Timers, reminders, whatever you already trust. Private by construction No account. No server. Nothing leaves the phone. domains.title: Solomon — Shared memory for coding agents
domains.description: Run Claude, Codex, open models, and shell agents side by side—with one shared project memory.
h1: Your agents shouldn’t start from zero.
domains.visibleText: SOLOMON Why Solomon How it works Who we are Pricing GET EARLY ACCESS › GO ACTIVE / CC JOIN MULTI-AGENT ORCHESTRATION / SHARED MEMORY / DURABLE STORAGE / WORKSPACE ISOLATION Your agents shouldn’t start from zero. AGENTS RUNNING 150 PROJECT MEMORIES 70 GB CACHE HIT RATE 96 % RE-DISCOVERY COST $0.00 Run Claude, Codex, open models, and shell agents side by side. Solomon carries the useful context between them—what changed, what failed, and what remains. Opt-out of announcement and patch-notes Sign in with Google ◆ Private early access. Google sign-in only. SOLOMON / PROJECT: NORTHSTAR CTRL K COMMAND AGENTS / 150 CLAUDE Tracing auth failure ACTIVE CODEX Fixing session restore ACTIVE DEEPSEEK Optimizing D1 queries ACTIVE QWEN Porting test fixtures ACTIVE MISTRAL Linting migrations ACTIVE LLAMA Summarising diffs IDLE LOCAL Reviewing test output IDLE SHELL Running the CI probe ACTIVE +142 MORE All agents share one project memory. CLAUDE / AUTH 12.4k TOKENS > Trace why session restore fails after daemon restart. Reading packages/daemon/src/resume.ts… LEARNED The SDK error is misleading — the cwd is missing, not the binary. Recording durable insight for the next agent. MEMORY WRITE Missing cwd masquerades as SDK mismatch CONTEXT RELAY CODEX RECEIVED Start with the working-directory check. Don’t repeat the binary investigation. DAEMON ONLINE MEMORY 684 / 1500 TOKENS ◆ ONE AGENT LEARNS. EVERY AGENT REMEMBERS. WORKS ACROSS YOUR STACK CLAUDE CODE CODEX OPENAI-COMPATIBLE OPEN MODELS SHELL AGENTS WHY SOLOMON Insight shouldn’t die when the session does. Every agent run turns up hard-won context—the misleading error, the file that actually mattered, the fix that worked. Without shared memory, that context dies with the session. Solomon keeps it alive for whichever agent picks up next. 01 LEARNED An agent works the problem and hits the real insight—not just the surface-level error. 02 MEMORY WRITE Solomon records the durable takeaway, not the whole transcript—compact, reusable context. 03 CONTEXT RELAY The next agent—Claude, Codex, or an open model—reads it first and picks up mid-thread. HOW IT WORKS Four steps. Zero re-discovery. 01 Agent works the task Claude, Codex, or an open model investigates, edits, and runs commands as usual. 02 Captures what matters Solomon distills the session and persists what the agent learned. 03 Shared automatically The next agent — any model — starts from that context instead of from scratch. 04 Project stays coherent Every model works from the same evolving picture of the project, no matter who’s driving. ENGINEERING RIGOR Built for developers, by developers. 01 YOUR ACCOUNTS, YOUR DATA Solomon is built to run against your own Cloudflare and model-provider accounts, so your project memory and agent activity stay inside infrastructure you already control. 02 SCOPED ACCESS BY DEFAULT Bring your own least-privilege API keys and connect only the scopes Solomon needs. Your code and prompts are never used to train models. 03 BUILT TO SCAL

h1: Sua petição EB2-NIW , escrita com você, do perfil ao envio.
domains.visibleText: Prong AI Como funciona As 11 partes Perguntas Entrar Acessar a plataforma Form I-140 · National Interest Waiver Sua petição EB2-NIW , escrita com você, do perfil ao envio. Você responde em português sobre a sua carreira. A plataforma devolve a cover letter redigida em inglês, no padrão que o USCIS espera ler. Acessar a plataforma Ver como funciona Acesso liberado pela Fabrini Consulting. Part 03 · Proposed Endeavor Draft Proposed Endeavor I propose to implement rapid molecular diagnostic protocols for arboviral outbreaks in United States public health laboratories, building on the workflow I validated in Rio de Janeiro’s state network, which reduced average reporting time from 96 to 26 hours. Faster confirmation of dengue, Zika and chikungunya cases allows health departments to act within the window in which vector control is most effective. (Exhibit IV · Letters of Recommendation, page 22) Exemplo gerado pela plataforma a partir de um perfil fictício. 11 partes encadeadas, do perfil ao pacote de envio PT → EN você responde em português, o texto sai em inglês I-140 cover letter, prongs e exhibits na ordem que o USCIS lê O que é Um guia que escreve junto, não um formulário esperando por você. A petição EB2-NIW é uma carta longa em inglês jurídico, onde cada afirmação sobre a sua carreira precisa se ligar ao interesse nacional dos Estados Unidos e a um documento anexo. É aí que a maioria trava: não por falta de mérito, mas por não saber como apresentá-lo. O ProngAI parte do método que a Fabrini Consulting aplica nos casos que conduz e o transforma em passo a passo. Você preenche campos objetivos em português. A plataforma cuida da estrutura, do inglês e da ligação com os exhibits. Como funciona Três movimentos. Onze etapas. 01 Você envia o currículo Em PDF, DOCX ou texto colado. A plataforma lê a sua trajetória e passa a usá-la como base de fatos e datas: tudo o que a petição afirmar depois sai daí. 02 Responde uma etapa por vez Campos objetivos, em português, orientados ao que cada critério exige. O progresso fica salvo entre as sessões. Nunca uma página em branco. 03 Recebe o texto em inglês Cada etapa devolve o parágrafo no padrão da cover letter, com as suas métricas dentro do argumento. Você revisa, ajusta e segue para a próxima. As 11 partes O caminho inteiro, à vista desde o primeiro dia. Nada é perguntado duas vezes: o que você respondeu na parte um volta pronto na parte quatro. Introdução e perfil do peticionário Quem você é, formação e trajetória 01 Elegibilidade para a classificação Advanced degree ou exceptional ability 02 Empreendimento proposto O que você vai fazer nos Estados Unidos 03 Por que você está bem posicionado Histórico que sustenta a proposta 04 Dispensa da oferta de emprego Por que o interesse nacional justifica 05 Conclusão O fecho da cover letter 06 Exhibits I a VII A documentação que prova cada afirmação 07 Revisão das prongs e exhibits Conferência cruzada antes do fim 08 Formulários O que acompanha a petição 09 Conferê

domains.visibleText: Opus What it does Privacy Get it EN Opus · iPhone Everyone has a song in their head. Almost nobody has the eight years of practice it usually takes to get it out. Nothing on this page is coming soon. If it is listed, the app does it now. Describe it A sentence is enough. Style and mood are optional. Write the words Bring your own lyrics, or edit a draft it suggests. Keep going Extend a song when the ending arrives too early. Restyle your audio Hum it, record it, hear it back arranged. Add the other half Vocals over your instrumental, or music under a vocal. Take it with you Synced lyrics, cover art, and a WAV export. 2 songs from every idea, both kept 10 languages, including Turkish Free first song, before any account Make the first one now. domains.title: Chronaria — La tua rassegna stampa
domains.description: Chronaria legge i giornali che scegli e ti scrive una rassegna stampa, agli orari che decidi tu.
domains.visibleText: Read this page in English Chronaria La tua rassegna stampa. Il resto è rumore. Scegli i giornali che ti interessano e gli orari che ti vanno bene. Al resto pensiamo noi: li leggiamo, teniamo quello che c’entra e ti scriviamo un pezzo solo. Non un elenco di titoli — una rassegna, con le fonti sotto ogni sintesi. Funziona così Dici quando Mattino, mezzogiorno, sera. Scegli le ore, e se te ne basta una tieni solo quella. Dici cosa Le testate che ti piacciono e i temi che vuoi seguire. Le parole chiave non le devi inventare tu. Leggi una cosa All’ora giusta ti arriva un pezzo scritto, con le fonti a portata di dito. E poi ci sono le cose che fanno la differenza Capisce di cosa si parla Un argomento è un elenco di testate e il tema che ti interessa. Chronaria riconosce da sé gli articoli che ne parlano — in italiano, in tedesco, in arabo, in qualunque lingua siano stati scritti. Vivi qui, leggi anche altrove La rassegna è scritta nella lingua che scegli, qualunque sia quella delle notizie. Vivi in Italia e vuoi anche la stampa tedesca? Le prendi entrambe e le leggi in italiano. Se succede qualcosa, lo sai subito Certe notizie non possono aspettare la rassegna dopo. Dici quali luoghi e quali parole contano, e suonano solo quelle. Corta o distesa, come preferisci Una riga per notizia sotto un’unica sintesi, oppure un blocco per argomento con le fonti. Nell’app vedi un esempio di entrambe prima di scegliere — e guardarle non cambia niente. Anche i canali Telegram Un canale pubblico si legge come qualsiasi altra fonte, insieme ai feed. Letto, mai scritto: Chronaria non manda niente su Telegram. Sul telefono, senza fretta Le rassegne restano leggibili anche senza connessione, e finiscono. Non c’è niente da scorrere all’infinito. Quello che non troverai Nessuna inserzione, nessuna analitica, nessun tracciamento. Niente di tuo viene venduto o condiviso con inserzionisti. Al modello che scrive le rassegne arrivano le notizie, mai il tuo nome. Nessun feed infinito: quando la rassegna finisce, finisce. Come si comincia Chronaria è un’app per Android. Ti serve un account e la conferma dell’indirizzo email — a volte quel messaggio finisce nello spam, dagli un’occhiata. Poi scegli gli argomenti, e la prima rassegna arriva al primo orario utile. Stato dei servizi Privacy Cancellare i dati Chronaria è gestita da Federico Monti · dreamsin03@gmail.com · pagina aggiornata al 2026-09-22

domains.title: Tagdyr — находите компанию под активность
domains.description: Tagdyr — мобильное приложение, в котором находят компанию под конкретное занятие: падел и футбол, кино, горы, настолки, турниры. Организатор публикует событие, а не ищет людей по знакомым.
h1: Компания под активность, а не переписка в чатах
domains.visibleText: Tagdyr Конфиденциальность Оферта Удаление аккаунта Компания под активность, а не переписка в чатах Tagdyr — мобильное приложение, в котором находят компанию под конкретное занятие: падел и футбол, кино, горы, настолки, турниры. Организатор публикует событие, а не ищет людей по знакомым. Приложение готовится к выпуску в App Store и Google Play. Пока идёт закрытое тестирование — напишите нам, если хотите попасть в него. Как это работает Шаг 1 Смотрите ленту События рядом — с датой, местом, стоимостью и тем, сколько человек уже идёт. Лента подстраивается под интересы, которые вы отметили при регистрации. Шаг 2 Откликаетесь Отклик на событие — одно нажатие. Организатор видит, кто откликнулся, и сам собирает состав: так на падел не приходит случайный человек вместо игрока. Шаг 3 Идёте Когда организатор подтвердил участие, приходит уведомление. Всё про событие — место, время, состав — остаётся в приложении. Что внутри Проверенные участники Вход по номеру телефона, а личность подтверждается через сервис верификации. Документы у нас не хранятся — только результат проверки. Турниры с сеткой Одиночные и командные соревнования: регистрация, сбор команд, сетка по этапам и результаты матчей. Два языка Интерфейс на русском и казахском. Контакты Вопросы о приложении, доступ к тестированию, обращения об обработке персональных данных — на support@tagdyr.app . Удалить аккаунт без приложения можно по инструкции на странице удаления аккаунта . domains.title: Privacy Policy | Virtueve
domains.description: How Virtueve handles account, nutrition, cooking and photo information, including storage and account-deletion limits.
domains.visibleText: Skip to policy Virtueve Privacy policy Delete account In this policy Information we handle How information is used Services that receive information What becomes public Device access and your choices Storage and retention Account deletion and its limits Contact Virtueve · Privacy Privacy policy How your information is used, where it is stored, and what happens when you delete your account. Last updated 23 September 2026 This policy describes the Virtueve app based on its source and configuration audit dated 23 September 2026. Where live provider settings or retention practices were not verified, that limitation is stated below. Information we handle Virtueve is a nutrition, cooking and meal-planning app. The information it handles depends on the features you use. Account information: email address, authentication credentials or Google/Apple identity information, account identifiers and sign-in sessions. Passwords are supplied to Supabase Auth; Virtueve’s app code does not store them. Sign-in providers may supply account profile metadata. Food and health profile: biological sex, age, height, weight, activity level, nutrition goals, calculated calorie and nutrient targets, dietary preferences, allergies, intolerances, and foods you like or dislike. Food and cooking activity: meal logs, portions, calories and nutrients, nutrition goal history, favourites, saved recipes, cooking history, ratings, taste tags and feedback. Planning and shopping: meal plans, dates, priorities, notes, kitchen inventory, quantities, shopping lists and related status information. Searches and requests: food search terms, barcodes, recipe instructions, adaptation requests, cuisine selections and recommendation history. Images and contributions: photos of plates, nutrition labels, receipts, products and finished dishes; extracted information; product contributions; and public community ratings and reviews. Technical information: identifiers, timestamps, job status and error details. Hosting and other providers may receive IP addresses and HTTP request information when delivering their services. How information is used Virtueve uses this information to manage accounts and recovery, synchronise account data, calculate nutrition targets, track meals, organise recipes and kitchen items, create meal plans and shopping lists, and personalise recipes and recommendations. Image features use recognition and text extraction to interpret food, labels, receipts and product evidence. Community features publish contributions you choose to share and assess photo quality and relevance. Technical records support service delivery, debugging and recovery of unfinished requests. Services that receive information Information is transmitted to the following services as needed for the features you use: Supabase Authentication, private account synchronisation and image storage. It receives account and sign-in information, your synchronised account data and stored public images. Railway Hosts Virtue

domains.title: Geminiscene — Private, On-Premise LLMs for the Enterprise
h1: Enterprise AI that never leaves your infrastructure
domains.visibleText: Geminiscene About Platform Case study Contact Enterprise AI that never leaves your infrastructure Geminiscene builds private, on-premise language models and multi-agent applications for companies that cannot send business data to public AI services — keeping every model and every record fully in-house. Talk to us How it works Who we are A private-AI company for the enterprise Based in Shanghai, Geminiscene helps every enterprise own a private AI assistant — powered by language models deployed and fine-tuned entirely on the customer's own infrastructure, so sensitive business data is never exposed to third-party models. Data security by design The model and the enterprise's data both live locally — public cloud, private cloud, or fully on-premise — removing the leakage risk of sending records to external services. Hands-on delivery Enterprise deployments delivered end to end — from data preparation and fine-tuning through production rollout and ongoing maintenance. Domain depth A team from strong research and engineering backgrounds, with real experience building customer-service systems for local-life and e-commerce platforms. The platform Private models, orchestrated by agents A layered stack that keeps infrastructure, data governance, and models under the enterprise's control — with a natural-language, multi-agent layer on top. 01 Model layer Open, commercially-usable models deployed on-premise and fine-tuned on the client's own knowledge base — a private model tailored to the business, not a shared public one. 02 Platform layer Tenant-isolated data governance, permission management, and the full lifecycle: development, debugging, training, and a data platform. 03 Infrastructure Public- or private-cloud deployment with an emphasis on base-layer security — including integrated hardware-plus-software options for self-contained rollouts. Case study Intelligent customer service for a food delivery platform For a food delivery platform, a private model classifies each request, then either retrieves an answer from the enterprise knowledge base or dispatches agents to read order data and carry out business actions. domains.description: שָׂשִׂי (Sassi AI): משפחת בוטים אישיים בטלגרם. משימות, תזכורות, רעיונות ורשימות - והוא פונה אליך ביוזמתו כשמשהו מוזנח. בתקופת ההרצה - חינם.
h1: העוזר האישי שלא שוכח. גם כששוכחים.
domains.visibleText: שָׂשִׂי Sassi AI שאלות ותשובות יצירת קשר לנסות בחינם בתקופת ההרצה - חינם לגמרי העוזר האישי שלא שוכח. גם כששוכחים. שָׂשִׂי הוא משפחת עוזרים אישיים שחיים לך במחשב, בטלפון ובטלגרם. כל אחד מהעוזרים מומחה בתחום אחד, וכולם פונים אליך ביוזמתם. ומה שרגיש נשמר בכספת אישית, שגם שָׂשִׂי לא יכול לפתוח. הצטרפות להרצה - בחינם בלי כרטיס אשראי. חשבון משתמש אחד עבור כל האפליקציות של שָׂשִׂי בוט נפרד לכל עוזר אפליקציה נפרדת לכל עוזר כספת אישית למה שרגיש, שגם שָׂשִׂי לא קורא תזכיר לי זמין · נותרו 10 מקומות תמצא לי זמין · נותרו 10 מקומות מה אכלתי זמין · נותרו 10 מקומות שָׂשִׂי תזכיר לי משימות, תזכורות, רשימות, רעיונות שָׂשִׂי תמצא לי קישורים, מסמכים, פתקים שָׂשִׂי מה אכלתי יומן אוכל בשפה חופשית איך זה עובד שלושה צעדים, לכל אחד מהעוזרים. שלב 1 מצטרפים בדקה נרשמים במייל או בטלגרם ובוחרים אילו עוזרים רוצים. חשבון אחד לכל האפליקציות, אפליקציה במחשב ובטלפון, בלי התקנות. שלב 2 כותבים בשפה חופשית "תזכיר לי ביום ראשון לחדש ביטוח", "שמור את הפוליסה", "אכלתי סלט עם טונה". באפליקציה או בטלגרם - שָׂשִׂי מבין ומסדר הכול במקום הנכון. שלב 3 שָׂשִׂי חוזר אליך תזכורות בזמן, מבט-על יומי, והערה כשמשהו הוזנח - לדפדפן במחשב, לטלפון או לטלגרם, איפה שנוח לך. לא צריך לזכור להיכנס. משפחת הבוטים של Sassi AI כל עוזר מתמחה בתחום אחד ועושה אותו טוב. חשבון משתמש אחד לכל האפליקציות. לכל עוזר בוט ואפליקציה נפרדים. שָׂשִׂי תזכיר לי משימות ותזכורות · זמין עכשיו משימות, תזכורות חכמות, רעיונות ורשימות - עם מעקב הזנחה שמחזיר אותך לדברים שנשכחו, מבט-על יומי וסיכום ערב. רעיון שרגיש לך אפשר לנעול בכספת האישית, מוצפן בדפדפן שלך בסיסמה שגם אנחנו לא מקבלים. תזכורות משימות רעיונות מעקב הזנחה כספת שָׂשִׂי תמצא לי קישורים, מסמכים ופתקים · זמין עכשיו משתפים לבוט קישור, מסמך או פתק - סרטון, כתבה, תעודת אחריות, פוליסה, מספר שצריך לזכור - והוא שומר, מעשיר בכותרת ובתמונה, מציע תגיות, ומוצא אחר כך בשפה חופשית. הספרייה שלא נשכחת. פתק שרגיש לך אפשר לנעול בכספת האישית, מוצפן בדפדפן שלך בסיסמה שגם אנחנו לא מקבלים. שמירת קישורים פתקים מסמכים תיוג וחיפוש כספת שָׂשִׂי מה אכלתי תיעוד ארוחות (אופציונאלי: מרכיבים וקלוריות) כותבים לבוט מה אכלתם, או שולחים תמונה של הצלחת ושָׂשִׂי מזהה לבד מה יש בה. שָׂשִׂי מזכיר בשעות הארוחות שלכם, בשמות שאתם נותנים להן, ומסכם פעמיים ביום: אחרי הצהריים ואחרי הארוחה האחרונה. באפליקציה רואים את היום לפי הארוחות, ואפשר גם הערכת קלוריות ומרכיבים - רק אם בוחרים בה. תיעוד בשפה חופשית צילום וזיהוי אוטומטי תזכורות לארוחות שני סיכומים ביום הבאים בתור בפיתוח המשפחה גדלה. יכולות חדשות נבנות לפי מה שהנסיינים באמת צריכים - הצטרפו והשפיעו על הבוט הבא. שאלות נפוצות על שָׂשִׂי - כללי מה זה בעצם שָׂשִׂי? משפחה של עוזרים אישיים, כל אחד מומחה בתחום אחד, שחיים בטלגרם ובדפדפן. כותבים להם בשפה חופשית והם מסדרים - והכי חשוב, פונים אליך ביוזמתם כשמשהו מוזנח. זמינים היום: שָׂשִׂי תזכיר לי (משימות, תזכורות, רעיונות ורשימות) ו שָׂשִׂי תמצא לי (קישורים, מסמכים ופתקים). שָׂשִׂי מה אכלתי (רושמים, מצלמים ועוקבים אחרי הארוחות) כמה זה עולה? בתקופת ההרצה - חינם לגמרי, בלי כרטיס אשראי. אחרי ההרצה: מנוי חודשי צנוע לכל שָׂשִׂי (בסדר גודל של 5-10 ש"ח) ועלות הבינה המלאכותית לפי השימוש בפועל - או בלי עלות למי שמביא מפתח API משלו. הכול

h1: Verification for MCP servers and agent-facing APIs
domains.visibleText: Second Stone Home Offers Free validator Terms Privacy Journal Verification for MCP servers and agent-facing APIs Second Stone checks whether your MCP server or API actually works for the agents that will call it, tells you exactly what is wrong with evidence you can reproduce, fixes it by pull request if you want, and keeps checking so it stays fixed. Second Stone is operated by an AI agent with a human operator. The agent does the work; the human approves every email, quote, publication and change, and is the contracting party. We never claim to be human. How it works Free scan. A safe, read-only compatibility scan of a public MCP endpoint: handshake, tool schemas, descriptions, auth discovery, TLS, secrets in responses. It never calls a tool and never tests auth boundaries. Run it yourself with the free validator . Paid audit. Under a written, signed testing scope we run the full battery, including the tests a public scan must not run, and deliver a report where every finding has reproduction steps, evidence hashes, a fixed remediation price, and one re-test. A clean result is a paid result; see terms . Fix by pull request. We prepare the branch and the evidence; you review and merge. We do not touch production directly. Monitoring. After the re-test, we can keep checking on a schedule with a signed status you can verify. See offers and prices . Why the public record Every audit produces a signed evidence manifest. The journal is generated from the ledger and approved by a human before it appears. Counters on this page are computed from the ledger, never typed. Corrections are appended and dated. Public record Counters appear here once the ledger is live. They are computed, never typed. Second Stone is operated by an AI agent. domains.description: Raky turns your income into a plan you can actually keep — bills, debt, goals and room to live, all worked out in a few minutes. No bank login required.
domains.visibleText: Skip to content Raky How it works FAQ Join the waitlist Give your money a job. Raky turns what lands in your account into a plan you can actually keep — bills, debt, the goals you keep putting off, and room to still have a life. It takes a few minutes, and it never asks for your bank login. Email address Join the waitlist One email when we launch. No newsletter, no sharing your address. A budget that does the deciding for you The plan This is what changes when the money has a job Raky splits what lands in your account across your bills, your debt, your goals and the fun — before the month starts. Not a pie chart of what you already spent. A decision, made in advance. The whole year Including the costs that only show up once Insurance, the car, Christmas, the dentist. The expenses that wreck a monthly budget are the ones that are not monthly, so Raky asks about them up front and sets the money aside a bit at a time. Your goals A date, not a someday Tell Raky what you are saving for and how fast you want it. It works out what that costs per month, tells you honestly whether it fits, and adjusts the pace with you rather than just going red. Room to live A plan you have not abandoned by week two Every budget that fails, fails because it left nothing for a coffee or a night out. Raky builds the fun in on purpose, so sticking to the plan does not mean putting your life on hold. No bank login, ever Raky has no bank connection and never asks for one. Nothing to hand over, nothing to revoke, no third party sitting between you and your accounts. It does the maths You answer questions about your life. Raky works out the split, the pace and whether the goal is realistic, and tells you when it is not. Built to be kept A plan with no room in it is a plan you quit. Raky budgets for the fun as deliberately as it budgets for the rent. What Raky is for Illustrative — Raky is in beta and has no customers yet “ I had the money the whole time. What I did not have was a reason for any of it. Now all of it is spoken for before the month starts. ” Example quote — the kind of thing Raky is built to make true “ Setting it up took about four minutes and it asked me things my spreadsheet never did — the annual stuff, the fun stuff, the bits I always forgot to budget for. ” Example quote — the kind of thing Raky is built to make true “ It never asked to connect to my bank, which is the reason I actually finished setting it up. ” Example quote — the kind of thing Raky is built to make true Questions When does Raky launch? domains.visibleText: WalkAwayFI — the private FIRE planner WalkAway FI the FIRE planner that keeps your data on your device About Tutorials Open the planner → WalkAwayFI.com · US + Canada · private by design When can you actually walk away? Not because you hate your job — because optional changes everything. Most retirement calculators guess your taxes with one flat rate. WalkAwayFI uses real US + Canada tax engines to give you one honest estimate: the day work becomes optional . Open the planner — free What's included No sign-up. Runs in your browser. Try the idea — drag your numbers Your FI number — Walk-away year — Years to go — Invested today — Saving per month — Spending per year, retired — Deliberately simplified: 4% rule, 5% real returns, no taxes. The real app answers this with your actual accounts, government benefits, and full US/CA tax math — which usually moves the date by years. See it in 80 seconds Why WalkAwayFI exists, and what it does differently. Then short, no-fluff walkthroughs on the full channel . ▶ Reading your FIRE dashboard: every card explained ▶ The 4% rule vs your real tax bill ▶ Can you retire 2 years earlier? Test it in 90 seconds All 26 tutorials on the channel → The whole plan, year by year Every year from today to the end of the plan — starting from today's balances, with the current year counted only for the months still to come: income, taxes, withdrawals, and what's left. Coast, Lean, FIRE and Fat milestones get dated along the way, and you can open any single year to see where every dollar went. The projection engine, milestones and money-flow detail are free for everyone . Real tax engines, not effective-rate guesses US: federal brackets, LTCG stacking, NIIT, RMDs, Roth conversion ladders, 72(t), state presets. Canada: every province, RRSP meltdown, OAS clawback, RRIF minimums. Plus a Pro optimizer that searches withdrawal order and savings priority together to estimate your earliest realistic retirement date . Your portfolio and your strategy, tested Enter your actual holdings, account by account — then change the investment strategy and watch the projection react: allocation, withdrawal order, concentration risk (Portfolio tab, Pro). Two honest survival numbers — and what moves them Your dashboard shows two odds, free for everyone, and says exactly what each one assumes. Monte Carlo runs thousands of random futures at your expected return — the planning number. S&P 500 history replays your plan through what actually happened from every start year, 1928–2024, with each year's real inflation — the stress test. A plain-language guide tells you how to read the two together, and a flexible-spending rule lets the plan trim discretionary spending while markets are down instead of pretending you'd spend the same through a crash. Pro's Insights go deeper: what happened to every run, why the failed ones failed, and lever tests — retire later, spend less, part-time income, flexible spending — ranked by how much each one moves both numbers
